{#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, sorry about that, sunshine. When my wrath flares up, probably best to not be anywhere in the vicinity.
A momentary flash of anger was all! We gods are easily hurt, for a bunch of immortals.
Oh, enough of this. Let's turn our combined might back in the same direction, and move on.
Naturally!

2.Text: For certain!

1.Text: That light...

2.Text: He's here...

1.Text: {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, we've got a situation starting to unfold. A big crevasse opened up at the base of the mountain, and something's in there... something big. And it's {#Emph}breathing... {#Prev}suppose it's friendly...?
There anybody special in your life? A princess like yourself must have suitors of all sorts. I've had my share, though I'm not the marrying type, and besides, I don't think Hera would oblige...

They're saying you got Chronos, didn't you, sunshine? Last night at least, but that's the deathless Titans for you! Never staying down for long. Though you've something in mind for that, my sister says...
Sometimes I think Hermes must still be running about in the Underworld like he used to, as lately I can't seem to find him anywhere. He's been so cagey with me, too! Some messenger.
The light of day {#Emph}can {#Prev}be a bit harsh, so it's fortunate the Moon offers such a pleasant alternative. Selene's shine may be more to your liking, if you can even see her from there...
The night is young, and I found you already. You don't suppose some of my sister's tracking skill is starting to rub off on me, do you?
Hephaestus has been hard at work on our defenses, so I'm pleased you've heard from him. Don't take his surly manner the wrong way! He doesn't get out much, certainly not these days.

{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, you've met my stepmother, have you? I'm fortunate to feel loved, but Hera, well, I'm not her favorite. Long as no one leads her to believe you're Zeus's child, you will be just fine.
I'm a bit of a physician, sunshine, and my professional opinion is your vital signs are not the best right now. Although perhaps we can still get you back in shape...

If Typhon keeps coming back, eventually there may be no mountain here left to climb. I know my father and Queen Hera have a plan in case things could not get more dire, but I'm more optimistic for whichever plan you have in mind...
All right, sunshine... what do you say we cut the song and dance and set you up with something positively brilliant this time. See here!
I don't like getting swept up in our family's petty feuds, especially with older generations that apparently have nothing better to do. But you and I couldn't exactly sit this one out, could we?
That Photon I gave you has seen plenty of good use by now, hasn't it? I know you don't always need a light in the darkness like so many others, so I'm pleased it could help.
Much as I'd rather offer poetry and music, right now these shall have to do.
Well, sunshine, it's just the two of us again, now that you slaughtered every... what exactly do you call those? Well, no matter, here!
When Artemis first told me about you, I couldn't help but think of Demeter. She couldn't be there for your mother when Chronos struck, but I know she'll do everything she can for you.
Can't have a nice day out in the sun, well here's the next best thing!

I didn't think matters could get much more precarious for us, but if the Fates are truly gone, then... their prophecies about the future may not come to pass. They foretold our family's eternal rule over the world... what if they were wrong?
Thought you could use this extra bit of preparation before heading out again in earnest, Cousin! A bit of extra reassurance that you'll make it all the way.
Our world's been through worse times than {#Emph}this, {#Prev}Cousin! So I am told at least, I've not seen anything this bad. Still, it's nothing we can't handle, right?

Even though your mother and father are back, you can't just stroll down to the bottom of the Underworld, can you? Finding remnants of Chronos means re-creating the conditions in which you faced him before, something like that...?
Let's show them a dazzling display they won't soon forget.
Before you go charging off to battle and glory once more, please, allow me!
See, sunshine? Whenever you head out with the Harmonic Photon that you got from me, I won't be far behind. And you'll get a warm fuzzy feeling for good measure!

Lately I'm reminded just how frail mortals are... I never let myself get attached anymore. They can be so much like us, even beautiful, but there's all heartbreak watching them die. Their deaths aren't even the end, but they sure act like it!

The Fates are back, all three of them, sunshine! Such a relief to feel their prophecies again. They even now foretell the dawning of a new and different age. Plenty of time to prepare... though let's make the most of it, right?
I can't believe we've let those Satyrs overrun our mountainside... leave it to Dionysus to try and make friends with them, but I've had no such fortune, believe me.
To think we'd wage war against our own grandfather. Not that we should give Chronos that sort of credit. He's a disgrace to our line; a hateful Titan, not a god. Not family.
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, you seem unwell, Cousin. Either you're pushing yourself too hard, or your foes landed a few too many hits. Perhaps both. Take care, all right?
For all the Boons we've offered, you've given us quite the blessing in exchange. Olympus has powerful allies... well, you and Heracles, at least! But you have this spark so many others don't.
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, looks like I've run a little late, as you most likely could have used assistance from me prior to whatever gave you such a thorough drubbing. Try to hold on, all right?
Peace will come again eventually, but for now, we have a reputation to uphold.
You must be in the city of Ephyra to the west, a staging ground for our enemies... with the Underworld gates thrown open, Chronos can replenish his forces faster than we can kill them off.

If Prometheus truly had the foresight that everything would happen as it did... why bar your path and fight so fiercely, only to be defeated again and again...? Unless the dawning of a new age wouldn't come about in any other way...
Your foes won't so much as touch you once we dazzle them a bit.
Where there's light, there's hope, sunshine, so get set for some of each!
You're in the Mourning Fields. I wonder does the Hyacinth grow there... the flower of a gentle prince, long gone. Once the Underworld reopens, perhaps I could go seek him out.
I like being the god of many things... so many passions, and all the time in the world!
Do bide your time, sunshine. The Titan thinks he has us pinned, but we have the situation here under control! Just locked in a bit of a stalemate is all.
Hope you don't mind I call you sunshine, by the way! I mean it when I say it. I know you come from underneath the earth, but there's this brilliance about you. Your mother's side I guess.
How did there come to be so much deceit in this world, Cousin? Believe me, we've needed a god of truth around here sometimes. Happy to do it and hope it catches on.

So pleased you finally got to meet your brother by the way! Me, I have {#Emph}more {#Prev}than enough of those, but if you grew up as an only child, you could probably use one. And it's never too late to make up for lost time.
Must be something I can do to brighten up your evening there a bit?

We should be able to hold back Typhon for a while longer, especially now that you've shown us a thing or two about how it's {#Emph}done{#Prev}, sunshine. You're going after Chronos now, aren't you? Well ridding us of {#Emph}him {#Prev}certainly wouldn't hurt.
So you were born and raised in some secluded grove down there? No luxuries, mortal worshipers... so much living to catch up on once this ugly matter is resolved.
I caught merely a glimpse, though that was poetry in motion the way you handled yourself against that lot. Talent runs in the family! Some of us just wound up with a bigger share.
Word of advice about good Lady Aphrodite? Don't get distracted. She speaks of love and beauty, though she's no stranger to conflict. Perhaps my power can offset her own.
The surface used to be more pleasant. But ever since the siege, Uncle Poseidon has been going all out with quakes and cataclysms in response. Stirring up the land like it's his mixing bowl.
Where in blazes are you now, sunshine? It's like you're at the bottom of the sea. Wherever it is, it's awful dark, and as you know, I've always got the cure for that.
So you're a witch, are you? Interesting craft. Your magick-making words possess a certain rhythm and power. Poetry is much the same! Except its magick affects only the heart.
There's something exceedingly odd about tonight. Haven't we already had an evening just like this, down to the smallest detail? Your magick at work perhaps... as long as it isn't Chronos.
You were a little easier to spot with twin torches in hand!

For such a fearful lot, mortals sure love killing each other! There was this war they had a while back that even had us gods at one another's throats. I tried to settle it with plague and arrows and such, but {#Emph}no! {#Prev}Father wanted it to play out.
For all the Boons we've offered, you've given us quite the blessing in exchange.
You got there faster than expected, which might mean you got a bit of a boost from Hermes! He's swift for sure, though I can never get a straight answer out of him about anything...
Just getting started for the evening, are you, sunshine? Don't know about you, but I've got a good feeling about how this is going to go!

Even if you managed to make Chronos see the light, the Three Fates are still missing. And we're supposed to believe he doesn't know where they are? This couldn't possibly be what they wanted or foretold...
My half-sister Athena knew your brother well, and sends her regards. She's preoccupied with our defense, leading our front-line forces and all that! She regrets that she can't aid you thus.

It's complicated who owns what up here. You know Helios the Sun? He's back to tramping across the sky in his chariot like nothing's changed, but he'd be lost without {#Emph}my {#Prev}light! {#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, Titans. What can you do?
Talent runs in the family! Some of us just wound up with a bigger share.

My sister Artemis once also trained with Hecate, you know! Trained in {#Emph}what{#Prev}, however, I have no idea. I still remember how they'd howl at night like a pack of wolves, {#Emph}heh{#Prev}. Bit unnerving, honestly!
You seem a bit out of sorts, sunshine. I'm supposed to be the god of healing, though even I can't aid you all that much in your present state. But let me see what I can do.
Brighter days are ahead, just have to get through this rough patch.
You're going to put on a brilliant performance tonight, Cousin.
Such a dark and oppressive night this is shaping up to be...
No wonder Chronos hates us, right? Admittedly we've got some prickly personalities here, but for all our quirks, we're family; and we stick together. Something Titans wouldn't understand.
I rather hoped old Chronos and his ilk would have seen the light by now, but alas. We'll just have to keep shining it in their faces for a while.

When I first reached out to you many nights ago, I figured, {#Emph}hey, another cousin! I like those! {#Prev}But the truth is I never expected you to make as great a difference as you have. My hope is I've done my part to make it possible.

So we're now working to prevent even the {#Emph}possibility {#Prev}that Typhon could have overwhelmed us here? And the Titan's forces are somehow part of this new plan. Well, if you're in, {#Emph}I'm {#Prev}in. Should make my evenings more exciting for a bit!
You seem fairer than ever, Cousin. Awash in moonlight...  you're working with Selene, aren't you? And here I thought she'd be too busy galloping across the sky to back us up...

Prometheus himself, leading the assault against us... one of our sole allies amongst Titankind, become a bitter foe. All because of how we treated him! Or because... he knows which side shall be victorious when all is said and done...
Before you go charging off to battle and glory once more, please, allow me! And may this blessing be of benefit every step of the way tonight.
Hey you got old Hestia to crawl out of the woodwork! She normally wants nothing to do with any of us, though this business with Chronos got her all worked up. Well, good!

I still can't entirely believe you {#Emph}got {#Prev}him, sunshine! Typhon should have taken the combined might of our entire family, and in a way he did, it's just... the rest of us were busy fighting back his swarms. He's really got us stretched thin.
I don't like getting swept up in family affairs, but I couldn't exactly sit {#Emph}this {#Prev}one out.
You were a little easier to spot with twin torches in hand... though yours don't seem to cast the customary kind of light! Truly the more I learn of you, the more questions I have!

Judging by all his vengeful roars, Typhon must hate my father almost as much as Chronos does. But are they truly working together? A monster such as that couldn't possibly be taking orders from a Titan, or anybody.
It's often said there's nothing new under the sun, though I've not seen a weapon quite like what you're wielding there! The legendary Arms of Night, Hephaestus says. Impressive stuff!
You've struck a solid blow against the Titan's forces, but they've started to regroup. Still, these types of victories must shake them to the core. Let's drive them back!
We'll keep holding it together on this mountaintop, just as long as you keep holding it together... wherever it is you happen to be! Take care, all right?
That Chronos is up to something, but not even Athena knows what. His assaults on Olympus always fail, even if they've kept us occupied. What's his next move...?
Just a spell, it's just another spell. Ten words... {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: Greetings from Olympus and well met, there, sunshine! Look, we can't get to the Titan, but if you truly mean to stop him, then the least I can do is light your way down.

1.Text: Won't take but a moment here and you'll be positively radiant, you'll see.
My word, you reached the {#Emph}surface{#Prev}, didn't you, sunshine? I thought your birthright meant you couldn't live up here...?
If Artemis was terse or impolite with you, don't take it personally, please. It's how she is with everyone. Always been the solitary sort, and we never know where she is when we need her.
{#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, this blasted war. Leaves little time for music or for poetry or any of life's joys. Though, it's brought the family closer together, I guess!

I know you're not one to complain, but it couldn't have been easy for you being at the Palace here at the break of Dawn... probably much more light than you're used to. We're hardly used to it either now thanks to all of Typhon's storms.
At least my good half-brother Ares finally made an appearance. I was beginning to wonder if he'd ever show up! Though, he might have wondered that about me in the past...
Remember, don't go heading down into the dark without a light.

You're just outside of the Ephyra gates, aren't you? That city is beyond salvation; I know they used to worship your mother and father there, but still... if it were up to me alone, I'd sweep the place away and start anew.
May this blessing be of benefit every step of the way tonight.
Don't know about you, but I've got a good feeling about how this is going to go!
What sort of light can I provide for you today?
You ever wonder what light really is, Cousin? Can't grasp it in your hand, doesn't weigh a thing, yet it's all around us! A real mystery... I'm waiting for the mortals to figure it out!
You're brilliant without my light, though here's a little just in case.
Look at you, strutting through that Underworld as though you own the place!
You're more of a night person, aren't you, sunshine? Accustomed to the dark. Me, I'm more the broad daylight type, but hey, to each their own.
I'd rather we handled all this in the light of day, but whatever works!
Don't know how you managed all this time without so much as a ray of light down there. Different worlds, I guess, but sometimes good things happen when such worlds collide.
My light normally can't reach the depths of the Underworld, but you can change all that!

So you get to pick your poison between going after Chronos in the Underworld, or coming to our rescue here! Truth is there's been some dispute as to which is the brighter idea. But, you must know what you're doing better than we.

I always wished to see the House of Hades, though your father and mother have a royal guard I {#Emph}may {#Prev}have sent to their realm prematurely. It'd make things rather awkward if we ran into each other there...
Wait how exactly did you even get there, sunshine? Last I checked you were traversing someplace else entirely! But then I had a hunch to check {#Emph}again{#Prev}, and sure enough...
Tread lightly down there, and remember, we're with you all the way.
I'd cast a plague upon our enemies but think you'll do the trick.
Oh, this is going to be a sensational night, I can already tell!
Don't know how you managed all this time without so much as a ray of light down there.
Go on, sunshine, and may my light help guide you where you need to be.
What sort of light can I provide for you today? I've got hard light, soft light, blinding light, last thing a mortal ever sees light... you name it!
Wait, you're right on Olympus now, sunshine! So close to us, though I am painfully aware the worst is yet to come as you press on. Fortunately, I have the best for you right here!
From all of us upon Olympus, we are grateful for your ongoing support.
Chronos must have thought nothing could stop him if he unleashed Typhon, but he thought wrong. Let's throw everything we've got at him and finish this, sunshine.
We're all in this together till the end, sunshine! Whenever {#Emph}that {#Prev}is going to be, right?

The song Artemis and I composed, we call it {#Emph}Time Belongs to Us. {#Prev}Came up with it when our hope of overcoming Chronos was starting to slip, but my knack for prophecy told me we had to hold on...

I'm impressed our fathers reached an agreement about Chronos, and {#Emph}certainly {#Prev}did not expect they'd send him to the Isles of the Blessed! Best spot in all the Underworld, so I hear. May he keep it that way!

It was a joy and honor to accompany you to the Crossroads on Selene's silver chariot, Cousin. The ballad Artemis and I performed... that's the first we jointly composed. We don't always get along but you inspired us.
As god of prophecies, I'm certain that we're going to succeed. Exactly how, though, I can't say for sure. That's prophecies for you! Blasted frustrating things most of the time.
The other evening, we lost contact with you in the deepest level of the Underworld. Soon after, though, our enemies flew into disarray, at least for a while. Your doing wasn't it? Fine work!

You found a harmful trace of Chronos, now a trace of Typhon's next? Glad there's no real sign of them from where {#Emph}we {#Prev}sit... besides their scattered forces and the devastation that they caused, but that can be cleared up!
Look at you, strutting through that Underworld as though you own the place! Although perhaps you do? Not sure how it works with the succession plans down there.

Mortals look to us for guidance and inspiration. They must be {#Emph}horrified {#Prev}by what they're seeing of late! Half of them seem to be against us now. Let's hope it's the {#Emph}other {#Prev}half that's left once all this is over.
I like being the god of many things. There's light, and poetry, music, healing... so many passions, and all the time in the world. Why settle for just blacksmithing or what-have-you?
What is that fancy staff you've got, with a serpent coiled at the top? How strange, it's... reminiscent of a vision that I've had... about a masterwork that can do no harm...

Ever wondered just how gargantuan is Typhon, the Father of All Monsters, truly? Well, you need but pay a visit here and you'll find out! Till then, {#Emph}erm{#Prev}, we'll... just have to fend him off!

Aphrodite's been quite excited for you... she has a way of knowing everybody's supposedly-private lives, but if she's blessing your relationships, you're better off. Some of mine certainly could have used it...
As god of prophecies, I'm certain that we're going to succeed.
I confess I'm rather enjoying this particular song and dance.

Don't know what it is exactly but something about this night made me flash back to when first you contacted me in those very woods. Well, either strange forces are at work or just my imagination, right?

Didn't think we'd let Prometheus continue his assault like this. Some partnership we've formed, all so you can re-create the path you took to Typhon, to then face the monster's remnants on the summit as before...?

We've confirmed sightings of that {#Emph}Eris {#Prev}buzzing about. She's from your realm not ours, so you may be more privy to how come she's showed up uninvited! Though, that tends to be her style. Somebody needs to shoo her away, already...
The sightless Cyclops Polyphemus bars your passage, does he now? Don't know what good my light will do against the likes of {#Emph}him{#Prev}, though perhaps I can help get you there in one piece.
I never was particularly close with your father, but I guess neither were you. Always struck me as a gloomy sort, though he did seem to care a lot about his own. He'll get his justice yet.
Still no sign of Dionysus. I'd be worried if it wasn't him, but he gets like this. Sometimes I {#Emph}cannot {#Prev}believe we're related. I want a bit of order around here, he wants the opposite.

You can count on most of us, but I can't speak for Dionysus; don't even know where he is! I like a feast as much as anybody at the proper time, but the god of wine thinks the proper time is {#Emph}all {#Prev}the time.
There's no one god of vengeance on Olympus, because we all share that responsibility at times. Go on, take back what's yours.
Between us, I have never seen Ares so pleased as he has been recently. And I can probably imagine why. This war that we've been waging... it's a real piece of work, even for him.
Beneath our uncle Poseidon's affable veneer is a ferocity I've learned to carefully avoid. If he's backed you with his ocean-strength, you're better off. Go make the most of it!

When Artemis first told me your tale, I figured it was just one of her pranks. Taking on the Titan yourself, {#Emph}come on. {#Prev}But it {#Emph}did {#Prev}sound like something a vengeful child of Hades might attempt...
Artemis says you're rather musically inclined! Runs in the family, even your parents have an ear for it what with Orpheus as their court musician. He's the best I ever taught!
How fares your voyage here, sunshine? If only we could whisk you over with more-godlike means, but the skies are as treacherous as the waters... as I suspect you've noticed.
Couldn't help but notice there's no {#Emph}bow {#Prev}in your arsenal! Artemis and I, we figure why sully our hands when we can settle any ugly business from afar... although your magick may suffice!
Wonder what there is to do for leisure down in Erebus, when one isn't rigorously training to vanquish hateful Titans and such. There must be something...
Bit embarrassed to admit that I'm the god of prophecy, among everything else. I ought to have seen this Titan business coming! But I didn't... and old Chronos caught us out.
Cousin, weren't you headed to Olympus last I checked? Must have been waylaid by the Titan's thugs. Well, don't give up! Although I guess you wouldn't be there if you did.
Such a dark and oppressive night this is shaping up to be... even if I could illuminate all your foes waiting in ambush, I'm not sure you'd want to see them. Be very careful out there...

My father Zeus already got to you, did he? {#Emph}Blessed {#Prev}you, I should say! He's a god of many inclinations. But when our rule is threatened, or even insulted, no one fights back more fiercely.
What can we do but try and make these dark days a bit brighter, Cousin?

You trained under Hecate, the Witch of the Crossroads? She's well respected here, though we've not seen her in a while, of course. I often speak ill of Titans lately but I'm reminded that they're not all bad.
Thank you for this, Cousin!

Lord Apollo, my cousin, my friend! This Ambrosia reminds me of the moment I first saw your father's palace and heard your wondrous song. Thank you for letting me see our world in a new light, and for always believing in me.

2.Text: Believing in you couldn't have been easier, Lady Melinoë, even without this Ambrosia dancing with moon beams from the Crossroads. I feel truly blessed to have met you, and that my sister found you when she did. You're the greatest boon our family has received in a long, long time.

1.Text: They say this Nectar shines as brightly as the sun, Cousin. May it live up to such a promise, especially now that it's yours! I'm beyond fortunate to have you as a friend.

2.Text: Oh, you're too kind. You didn't have to get me {#Emph}this! {#Prev}I never knew you Underworld gods were so damn courteous. You know our customs better than {#Emph}we {#Prev}do!

1.Text: Cousin Apollo! I am grateful for all your warmth, benevolence, and aid! Please, accept this gift!

2.Text: An offering, for me? What a delightful surprise, and I haven't had a lot of those of late. Know what, I've something for you, too!

1.Text: My glorious cousin! It was you who first reached out to me of all those on Olympus. I've come this far because of you, and no matter what happens, I'll never forget the kindness you showed me.

2.Text: Come on, the pleasure is mine! It's not all sunshine on Olympus recently. But then I hear from you, and I'm left feeling everything will be all right. Don't quite know how that happened, but I'm very grateful that we met.

1.Text: Brilliant Apollo, your many talents must be the envy of all the land, and I am honored that you're sharing them with me. Here, this is for you!

2.Text: Come now, you truly shouldn't have. Such flattery's entirely unnecessary, I assure you! Although it's perfectly welcome!

1.Text: Dear Cousin, you must have Nectar in no short supply. But I know that the depth of the sentiment is what distinguishes one bottle from the next. So please accept this one; it should be good.

2.Text: I'm an Olympian; I'm used to glad-handers and sycophants. Everybody wants our favor, right? And I can smile and nod better than anyone, even Father. Yet with you... well, if only we had more chances to talk than trade in courtesies...

1.Text: I wonder, does this bottle's brilliant sheen come from the god of light, himself? Perhaps to him it should return, right now!

2.Text: Such a thoughtful gift! It's gracious of you to think of me like this, and during such a time. Though there's no need to go out of your way!

ApolloRejection04.Text: I have few weak points, but my pride is one. You got me where it hurts, so now I've got to get you back.

ApolloRejection10.Text: Beneath this sunny disposition, I have something of a vengeful streak, Cousin. Though I know actions speak louder than words.

ApolloRejection01.Text: You wound me, Cousin. After everything we've been through together, you'd brush me off so easily?

ApolloRejection08.Text: I have a reputation to live up to. I can't just let you brush me off like some pathetic commoner with nothing but a prayer!

ApolloRejection05.Text: Was it something I said or did? Or perhaps you don't respect my power. Even when it's turned against you thus?

ApolloRejection07.Text: Come on, sunshine, why the snub? You should know that when my feelings get hurt, it's never the only thing.

ApolloRejection09.Text: Perhaps someday we'll all be able to resolve our differences more sensibly. But we're the gods, and we're a family, damn it!

ApolloRejection03.Text: Not your first choice?! Perhaps you haven't heard, so I'll enlighten you: My generosity is not unlimited.

ApolloRejection06.Text: I go out of my way to offer you my strength, and you refuse? That's not something any self-respecting god can abide.

ApolloRejection02.Text: {#Emph}Augh! {#Prev}Now really isn't the time for petty squabbles, but I'm afraid you leave me with no choice...

1.Text: I know you were expecting me, sunshine, but my {#Emph}glorious {#Prev}stepmother the Queen would like a word! This instant... so I'd better step aside, all right?

2.Text: You see, my dear? There are yet those upon Olympus who show their Queen the proper deference. Seek not to earn the love of your subjects; make them a bit afraid, instead.

1.Text: You know, Cousin, one thing you and Hephaestus have in common is you don't seem to get a lot of sun! I often try to coax him from his cave, and while I usually fail, not {#Emph}this {#Prev}time!

2.Text: Come off it, mate, before the witchie catches on to your routine! Now make yourself useful over here, lest I stick this hammer right where {#Emph}you {#Prev}don't get a lot of sun!

1.Text: Ares and I were just chatting about how we seem to get on best when we're on the same side of a war. So, Brother, is this all an elaborate ploy to bring us closer together?

2.Text: I think it's merely that a proper war brings out the best in all of us; even in you, Apollo, and in me. The rigors of conflict forge unbreakable bonds! And make for powerful blessings.

1.Text: Great Hestia has joined us here, Cousin! Returned from all her journeys 'cross the world, to lend her wisdom in our time of need. Where glows her hearth-flame, you shall also find my light. And together, we can, {#Emph}oh—!

2.Text: {#Emph}Oh {#Prev}shut it, Golden Boy, we don't have time for pageantry! Instead, how about we show your wee cousin there how we can light up the night? Won't do for her to wander in the dark!

1.Text: Cousin, our uncle and I were just debating what to do about mortals who turned their backs on us... I think a year or so of plague should settle up the score! But, Lord Poseidon here thinks it's more important to {#Emph}go big...

2.Text: Why would you {#Emph}not {#Prev}go big, given the choice, my delicate nephew? I'll shake the earth so strongly it shall swallow all those nasty mortals up, and deliver them straight down into the arms of your comely cousin there!

1.Text: I, {#Emph}erm{#Prev}, lost my train of thought, Cousin, for Aphrodite here, she doesn't seem to understand the meaning of a {#Emph}private conversation. {#Prev}Lady, would you care to join us, then?

2.Text: Oh, dear Apollo, {#Emph}yes{#Prev}, I {#Emph}always {#Prev}care to join your conversations, {#Emph}especially {#Prev}the private ones! And is there any who could blame me? Love and sunshine go together, after all!

1.Text: All of us here want you to succeed, Cousin, though none so much as Lady Demeter... I'm reminded that you are her grandchild, after all. {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, wait, she wants to speak to you herself!

2.Text: Thank you for your advocacy services, Apollo. Should I have need of them again, I shall apprise you. For now, my granddaughter requires our abilities, not honeyed words.

1.Text: {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, greetings, honored Cousin! I'm here now with none other than the bringer of thunder and lightning, magnanimous King of Olympus, your great Lord Uncle and my illustrious father, Zeus!

2.Text: Oh, {#Emph}haha{#Prev}, my niece and I are well past such a level of formality, my son! Though while we have the pleasure of her company, what say we show her how we put the {#Emph}light {#Prev}into {#Emph}lightning?

1.Text: We'll shine so bright it hurts!

2.Text: No hiding from {#Emph}this {#Prev}light!

1.Text: Oh {#Emph}now {#Prev}you want my aid?

2.Text: Well I don't see why not!

1.Text: Hey little brother!

2.Text: Apollo?!

1.Text: Far too much blasted light...

2.Text: The light of the {#Emph}sun?!

1.Text: It's Apollo...!

2.Text: Hi Apollo...!

1.Text: It's him...
Mess with me, and it's lights out, sunshine.

2.Text: Need I remind you, I'm not always as nice as I look.

3.Text: Best not push the bounds of our relationship too far.

4.Text: I'm no less prone to wrath than any of us, Cousin.

5.Text: We Olympians can't all be the best; because it's my job.

6.Text: You left me little choice but the old show of force.

1.Text: We have to reach you however we can, and Charon's been more than keen to oblige. Bit of an odd fellow, but then, aren't we all?
Perhaps you knew this Boon was going to be mine, for how can my light be contained, even in a heavy parcel? It must have been glowing a {#Emph}little {#Prev}at least, right?
We started working with Charon back when we had to figure out a system to transport all the mortal dead down to your father's realm. Must be more pleasant hauling messages from us!
Normally my light makes it easy to spot whoever needs a blessing or a smiting, but you always seem to be in shadow! Fortunately, Charon seems to know how to get a hold of you!
That Boatman's something of a coin collector, isn't he? Well, once we're finished with old Chronos, all those Gold Crowns of his will be extremely rare collector's items!
It's fortunate the Underworld Boatman's still plying his trade even during a downturn such as this! I trust his prices have gotten better, at least? Or, perhaps worse...
Hello, sunshine!

2.Text: Hello, Cousin!

1.Text: All right, we're squared away for now, and break time's over. Back to work!
That's what I like to call {#Emph}hammering out the details{#Prev}. Leave 'em to me next time.
Was as close as I am liable to get to blowing up. Still working at it, mind!
Been working on my anger issues. Can't blow my top like some of the others here...
Don't let anybody know, but... I held off back there. 'Cause I ain't really mad.
All right, I count you settled up after all that. Time to get back to work!
Now that you've seen some samples of my work, perhaps you'd like some for yourself?
{#Emph}Eh! {#Prev}Fine, consider me appeased. But don't incur my wrath again lest I— I don't even know.
Don't take these fights too personal, it happens up here all the bloody time.
Congratulations, witchie, you survived. And here is what you won.
{#Emph}Hrm{#Prev}, that there was not the most productive thing I did all day, but {#Emph}eh... this {#Prev}ought to make up.
Some work you did! Though, looks like you could use some patching up.
All right, I'd say we're settled up! We can continue bickering another time.
{#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, no use staying mad over nothing! Wasn't all that mad, mind.

...Don't know where all these Satyrs, Harpies, and whatnot are getting their supplies. Mayhap looting the ones you dealt with just the night before? Either way, looks like old-world Cyclopean design to me. It's solid work!
Been keeping busy underground? I can relate better than anybody here.
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, it's been an awful lot of late! Don't sweat it, though. Always got room for you.
Reckon you're looking for another tune-up, no problem at all.

{#Emph}Whew{#Prev}, Aphrodite, she's a real force of nature, isn't she? And just about the only thing gets me to leave the forge! Not that she minds me working all the time. We've always had an understanding, I reckon!
Thought I was due to catch a break once all the fighting and whatnot had simmered down, but no! The fighting must go on, which come to think is no surprise, I mean, it's us! We find a way!
It's good to have you back up top, witchie, because things on the mountain are a little touchy still. Or are we keeping it that way on purpose? Either way, doesn't bother me.
Reckon my dad'll be of help in all this! Lord Zeus, he loves to help! Especially hisself... lot on the line right now, and you don't get to be the king of Olympus being coy.
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, think I got just the thing to help you with the killing-and-not-dying here, witchie.
I'm not the one out there taking hits. Least I can do is soften 'em for you.

All right, that's called Revaal, I think, that skull you got? Ain't exactly my mental picture of a weapon, liable to give me night terrors in fact, but... then I'll be the first to say, {#Emph}whatever works!

{#Emph}Say{#Prev}, where'd you get that silver armor you've got on? Much finer work than first I thought. Not too much coverage, mind, but you seem more the sort that likes to freely move about. Always a trade-off to be made!
So that's the Staff of Dusk, is it? Descura, that's her name! Forged who-only-knows-how-deep within the Earth under the watchful eye of Night... something like that.
Hold on, that's Ygnium you've got! The Flames of the Crossroads Witch! What, has the student become the master or somesuch, or is she just getting you to do all the dirty work?
No telling how many cousins I got, but you're another, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}You're getting special treatment only 'cause my mum and dad, they asked me real nice. Don't mind the extra work!

Oi, sorry 'bout all my Automatons up here. Heard you ran afoul of the lot! Tested 'em everywhich way... but not in this particular scenario. They give you any trouble, scrap 'em! You'll be doing me a favor.

I'll let you in on a secret, witchie. The best part of working a forge ain't even the weapons and armor you get, but the act of bringing 'em into being. A bit like children I reckon! Except harder to make than maintain.

I'll be the first to say one shouldn't judge by looks, but... I just didn't figure you to be so keen on proper weapon maintenance, 'cause yours are strong as hell! And making {#Emph}them {#Prev}shine makes {#Emph}me {#Prev}shine.

So, you're a witch or something, I'm to understand? Then what do you need {#Emph}me {#Prev}for? Mayhap that fancy magick of yours ain't all it's cracked up to be! {#Emph}My {#Prev}work, witchie, is reliable.
Where do you think you're off to, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Best not head out against {#Emph}impossible {#Prev}odds whilst unprepared, so here! Let's get you suited up right quick.
Oi, there's no sign of Dionysus still? Must have been quite the feast he had if he's still nursing it away! {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, some like working and some don't. What can you do?

Feel any tremors, they are probably Uncle Poseidon shaking up the place. Though there {#Emph}are {#Prev}times it's me! When Earth herself gets angry with the state of things, I give 'er a good outlet to let off a little steam.

They come to me sometimes and ask, {#Emph}where's Ares? {#Prev}Like I'm supposed to know just 'cause we got a brotherly connection? It's bloody {#Emph}war! {#Prev}Must be he's out there having a great time!

Wait... has Typhon been destroyed or no? Not seen much sign of monsters, which ain't known for subtlety. But then I heard my dad talking about how {#Emph}you've {#Prev}been dealing with their remnants here. Mayhap they're real small!
Oi, you got something from Daedalus already? Well I can work with that.
Oi, that is Zorephet the Moonstone Axe, all right! Though not expected ever to lay eyes on it. Some mortals worship the labrys, you know? Here! Let's give 'em something to believe in.
Wonder what Chronos did to Tartarus? Was quite the architectural feat under your mum and dad! But the Titan hasn't got any taste. Probably turned everything to gold...
Well, you look plain awful right now, and that's coming from {#Emph}me! {#Prev}Though hey, you get a free weapon service with the, {#Emph}erm... {#Prev}unwelcome remark.

Normally, it'd be ever-wise {#Emph}Athena {#Prev}who'd be first to greet you and make nice, but... she's been busy putting all my arms and armor to the test. Good news is, the {#Emph}testing's {#Prev}going well!
You work for the family, you're entitled to the family protection plan.
You've been on a proper rampage, witchie! So let's see you keep it up.

{#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, not met your dad, but... heard plenty about him. Shame, might've gotten on better with him than the rest. Likes his metals and gemstones and such as I'm to understand, so... we'd have that at least.
Got to keep on climbing up here, I'm to understand? Bit of {#Emph}insurance {#Prev}against any other Typhon-like events... and you and Chronos and the lot of us are gonna see to that? Well all right!
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, it's that staff again... well, mayhap I can do something about the knots at least.
So we've got Titan problems real close to home! Blasted shame about Prometheus, but then... I reckon if Dad chained {#Emph}me {#Prev}up and had an Eagle chew my liver everyday, I'd be mad too.
{#Emph}Ohh{#Prev}, this is going to be a real piece of work, since Daedalus already left his mark! I'd bless that dead old busybody bastard if I could, but I can never pin him down.
You know, the more I work those weapons, the more intricacies I can find...
{#Emph}Ohh, there {#Prev}you are! We'd lost you for a bit! Must have gone so deep, we couldn't spy on you no more. Well, you've still got your arms and legs! Must have turned out all right.
See you still got that Adamant Shard I sent over before! Just a bit of scrap, really, but... it's a shiny one, and has some decent heft. And I can use it to pinpoint you {#Emph}quick!
{#Emph}Eugh{#Prev}, you're in shambles there, witchie. Mayhap this'll be too little too late! Could've come in handy earlier.

Keep a secret, witchie? The last resort my mum and dad asked me to build would never work. Our king and queen commissioned it to feel like they had everything in hand. I gave 'em that feeling, but... that's all I'll give 'em.

While back, your brother came to us for help, what's his name... {#Emph}Zagreus? {#Prev}I wasn't having it. This family's problems would disappear overnight if we could just stop getting in each other's business! Felt bad sitting it out, though...
Brought out those blades for yet another go! I really like the curvy one!
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, fancy meeting you again and all, now let me get to work.

Wracked my brain about those fancy silver weapons of yours, trying to sort out who exactly could have made such things... or when? They're the Nocturnal Arms, ain't they? Meant only as a last resort! But here we are, I reckon.

{#Emph}Oi{#Prev}, I take back {#Emph}everything {#Prev}I said about your weapon first we met. In my defense, ain't often I see workmanship superior to mine! Though, don't go telling anyone I said as much...
I just had the strongest urge to bang on solid metal for a bit.
Well, if it ain't my finest client! Reckon we've reached the stage of our relationship where I needn't be conversing much, and can stick to what I do best. Keep sticking, too, witchie!

Not letting you back in the Palace, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Don't take it personal, it's just our bloody pride! Mum and dad aren't keen on taking guests till everything is {#Emph}perfect{#Prev}, but... it never really is.
Oi, wanted to catch you right on your way out! Got a special this evening: free tune-ups for secret silver weapons, if you got one there?

Oi Aphrodite seems to like {#Emph}you {#Prev}quite a bit! Likes just about everybody, granted, but with you it's different. She'd never fess to it though I reckon she gets a bit lonely here, you know? Lots of acquaintances, not many friends.
Time for more spelunking, {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, witchie? Going damn near to the bottom of the bloody earth! Must be good rocks and metals and such there. Your dad got all the hidden gems!
Say, what's that you got there, witchie, a nice weapon of some sort?

Everybody here is going off about the Fates deciding to show up unceremonious, to which I say: so what? Nobody knows what they're doing, {#Emph}them {#Prev}least of all. {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, mayhap I'm just jealous they'll be taking time off work...
Fresh-faced Apollo got to you before me, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Well ain't that a surprise. He can help boost your spirit, {#Emph}I {#Prev}can boost your weapon. Tough choice, isn't it?

Am I to understand you gave a certain {#Emph}Titan {#Prev}a right thorough walloping of late? Mayhap {#Emph}I {#Prev}helped in my own way? Not like you took down Chronos with your bare hands, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Point is, {#Emph}good job{#Prev}, witchie!
Using the classic staff tonight? The kind I make can't shoot, but... yours is giving me ideas.
So you took some hits along the way, so what? You're an extension of your weapon, witchie! And a decent one can take a lot of punishment.
You might have thought I'd fix up my Automatons by now... or you're used to destroying them on sight. Well now you know how {#Emph}they {#Prev}feel! Don't reckon they feel anything, mind.
Your suit seems in fine working order, though a tune-up couldn't hurt.
There's talk up here that Chronos made off with the Fates or something like that? Well... those three have messed with all our lives so much, suppose it's only fair, ain't it?
You got the Sister Blades of Lim and Oros, {#Emph}huh? {#Prev}Delicate-looking, but damn near indestructible! Light as a feather, too. {#Emph}This {#Prev}is going to be a treat!

Oi, where'd that great big monster out there go? The mountain's rumbling's all settled down and now my clanging's just about the worst of it. You got him then? {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, I didn't even get to have a look.
Fine evening to you, witchie! My work ain't quick, but sometimes {#Emph}I {#Prev}can be. And here I thought, why don't I join her from the get-go, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Can't hurt!
Welcome to the fine city of Ephyra, witchie! Most important thing to know is, whatever happens to you there, {#Emph}I {#Prev}cannot be held liable. I work weapons, not miracles...
Right clever of old man Chronos to recruit a bunch of bitter dead against us, ain't it? We got them killed in wars and such... reckon the payback's only fair. More chances for my handiwork to shine!
Fine suit you got there, witchie! Though, reckon we could spice it up a bit!
Something's been going on out there, the others saying it's a proper nasty night! Makes no difference in my forge, but... sounds like you are really in for it, witchie.
The Titan really nestled up right in your mum and dad's House, ain't that right? Now that's properly offensive... somehow more than sending all his armies after us!
So Mum gave you her blessing, just like {#Emph}that? {#Prev}Hard won's the favor of Queen Hera. Whilst mine... reckon it's a bit easier to come by...

I can appreciate an armament of damn near any shape or size, but... ones shaped like that Moonstone Axe you got might be my favorite were I forced to choose at weaponpoint. Let's see what you can do with it, witchie!
That skull is not exactly in my area of weapons expertise, but I can tell it works!
Had an opening come up in my schedule, so I figured why not get your gear back to better-than-new condition right from the start?

Off to pay us all a visit then, or try? Reckon you're liable to get into a {#Emph}tussle {#Prev}or two on the way, but... I can offer a {#Emph}complete {#Prev}protection plan against that sort of thing!
When old Hestia said she liked you, 'twas all I needed to hear. The forge would be no good if not for her! She sparks the flame, I bend the metal, and {#Emph}you {#Prev}get the benefits.

This lot up here act like they all was born with all the talent in the world! Mayhap Apollo and Athena, sure, and Artemis, and Hermes... Aphrodite definitely, too, but, {#Emph}erm... point is! {#Prev}Most of us, we got to {#Emph}work {#Prev}at things before {#Emph}we're {#Prev}any good.
I keep forgetting that you're Demeter's grand-kid! Can't stand being around her myself. Nothing personal, mind, I just can't get anything done when it's so blasted cold.

{#Emph}Oi! {#Prev}What are you doing on {#Emph}this {#Prev}side, you lose your way? Thought you had business in the Underworld, not here. Mayhap I'm just a bit out of the loop is all... you need this stuff or not?
Heard you talked to mum and dad, face to face! Not even {#Emph}I {#Prev}get to do that much. Must have been right nervous meeting 'em. Or mayhap not considering what you did to get there.

Am I mistaken, witchie... or are you bearing Xinth the Black bloody Coat? {#Emph}Wearing {#Prev}it, I should say! Heard how it's put together but I've never seen it for myself! Let's see what it can do.
Fine couple of knives you got there, witchie. Though let's make 'em proper vicious here.
Got to say, when we first met, I was uncertain what to make of you. Don't always trust you witchy types is all. But, if you're worthy of Aphrodite's blessing, you get the package deal.

What I {#Emph}really {#Prev}want to know is, how'd you blast old Typhon into smithereens? Don't have much here could've done something like {#Emph}that{#Prev}, least not without taking the summit too. You got to let me in on it sometime.
I always like it when you use Xinth the Black Coat. Makes everything go {#Emph}boom!
Never thought of using torches for a weapon, but you really make it work!
Oi {#Emph}there's {#Prev}my favorite Moonstone Axe! Go cleave something in two for me, witchie.
I heard the latest, witchie, that you're headed for our mountain tippy-top! Just don't expect warm welcomes when you get here, as we are a... a bit preoccupied right now?
Oi, you're about due for another servicing appointment on that thing.
What, is he going to fit me for a suit of armor? {#Emph}In the name of Hades! Olympus, I accept this message!

2.Text: Oi, you that new cousin of mine? They told me you needed a weapon or something. {#Emph}Ach{#Prev}, you already got one! Right lousy one, can spot {#Emph}that {#Prev}piss-poor workmanship from here. Though, I {#Emph}could {#Prev}tune it up...

1.Text: Apologies if my Automatons make any trouble for you whilst you're here.
Come on up, the weather's fine! So I hear. Been in my forge a while now.
How many blasted weapons do you even have by now, witchie? Long since lost track of all their forms and such, but it's a {#Emph}lot! {#Prev}You've given me so much to work with here!

{#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, wanted to say cheers for keeping Aphrodite company, being a decent listener and all. Me? I find talk more tiresome sometimes than this here forge... but not with her. Anyway! Small thing, big help.
I always said a bit of evening work is good for you, witchie.
Soon as I'm through, you go knock some sense into some wretches for me, would you?
{#Emph}Ehh{#Prev}, turns out torches ain't just for lighting your way! Let's see 'em here.
{#Emph}Ohh{#Prev}, right sinister choice of weapon you got there, witchie.
All sorts of silver I can work with in that skull of yours, so put 'er up!

Never knew your family, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Better off if you ask me. Though you... didn't ask me. Probably wouldn't even if you could, and I'm also keenly aware you're expecting my services not my opinions, so, {#Emph}erm{#Prev}... here.

{#Emph}Ohh {#Prev}now what is that you've got, witchie? If I know anything of weaponcraft then that is {#Emph}definitely {#Prev}not from around here. Must still be one of those Nocturnal Arms of yours. Go on, give us a show!
You've not seen Dionysus, right? Probably just getting sloshed somewhere is all. Don't like when everybody's fighting... can you blame him?

Now hold on, that another weapon you got...? {#Emph}Ahh, right{#Prev}, the Nocturnal Arms and their shape-shifting tricks. Figures! You witches {#Emph}like {#Prev}changing things about, as I'm to understand.
Only so much I can do when you're out and about with that walking stick, you know.
Bringing a couple flaming sticks to a fight? Well, whatever works, witchie.
Who needs witchery when you can go on brandishing an axe like that?
{#Emph}Ahh{#Prev}, brought my favorite out to play, did you? Just needs a tune-up and you'll be all set.
Hold up those flashy blades of yours for me and I'll have 'em sharper than ever.
I don't normally just give away my services, but it ain't normally of late.
Don't know if it's your silver gear or what, but for a bit there I thought I was staring at the Moon... don't much get to see the Moon in my line of work.
How's it going and the like, all good? All good, that's great, now here.

Dark times of late, witchie, but what can you do? Tell you what {#Emph}I {#Prev}can do: I can sit here sweating over my forge, clanging away at armaments and such. So blasted hot and loud in here, nobody dares disturb my work. Ain't bad!
You got a dangerous line of work, witchie. Though I can get you some protection here.
How's things there in the Underworld, all right? Here they're not bad.

I tried to make it so that Talos would begin to learn as he encountered different combat situations and the like, but... I ain't seen much evidence that's doing any good. He's not been too much of a pain has he?
Your mum and dad are both all right, ain't they? This Chronos business must be pretty tough for them, if they're anything like mine. Although they don't seem anything like mine last time I checked.

My mum or dad mentioned our last resort, did they? The way some of my Boons go {#Emph}clang{#Prev}, imagine that but bigger by, oh... let's just say {#Emph}a lot. {#Prev}Not keen to ever use it, mind, as then my forge would go {#Emph}kaboom!
Don't know what's been with all the rumbling of late, but it ain't Poseidon, and it ain't my forge. Probably something bad! But, I ain't sweating it till I know what it is.
Don't sweat it, you'll be as good as new here in a bit.

Run into Artemis, don't worry, she's been notified her next supply of arrows is already on its way. Chews through those things right quick, but damn if it ain't economical! She must be averaging a kill and a half per shot.

Don't know what's such a big a deal with the Three Fates going on about a distant time. You're telling me that in the span of, I don't know, twenty-something mortal generations, things might change? {#Emph}Ach {#Prev}you don't say!
You've met most of the lot up here by now. So now you know how come I'm cooped up in this forge. The work needs doing, not to mention it's less tiring than being with the family all the time.
Just clanking away as always, though let's do some clanking now on your behalf.
You still alive, witchie? Here, this ought to keep it that way.
Stockpiling some of our Adamant, {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, witchie? Thought I might ask you give it back, but we've enough for now. And I reckon you'll put it to proper use. Good stuff, ain't it?
Where'd you get off to, witchie? The Underworld's gutter from the looks of it, all cold and wet... piss-poor working conditions, that much is clear.

Know what I learned in all this, witchie? {#Emph}No time like the present. {#Prev}Whatever happened in the distant past ain't my fault! Might be my problem though! As for what happens in the future, {#Emph}ach{#Prev}, I'll handle it then. Well, back to work!

So Grandpa Chronos keeps on lending us a hand! To deal with what he did to us, but still! I reckoned he'd be back to his old self by now, but... mayhap you scrambled him enough that it'll stick. {#Emph}Heh... {#Prev}think you could do that to my mum?
Oi witchie, let me see about that hunk of metal you got there.
Oi, you made it all the way up to the mountain earlier? I'd give you a tour of the old forge next time, it's just... it's sealed up. Damn near impossible to find! Security's sake.

I like making armaments fit for killing mayhap one, two, let's say up to fifteen at a time? But more than that at once takes all the sport away! Mum and Dad don't get it, they just want to kill 'em all. Ares kind of gets it, though.

All this warring, bit concerned I'll end up typecast as a weaponsmith! I make a lot of things, you know! Jewelry, fancy chairs, walking Automatons even! Though lately, it's all weapons, all the time...
Ain't you not supposed to be able to breathe up here or something? Well, what can you do but push on through, is what I say! Ain't always easy but we manage or we try.
You look like you've been beaten like a chunk of ore! Just keep it together long enough to appreciate my handiwork.
Must think I got it all up here, don't you? Well you'd be right! But let's just say you're not the only one who had to learn things the hard way, witchie. I needed to do what I do.
Heard Eris got her poor wings plucked, witchie! Next make her hand over her Rail of Adamant, would you? Shoots faster than any bow I've seen! Demands a closer look...!
Must like to run about don't you? Me, at this point I would rather sit. And so I do! Won't find a better set of legs than this anyplace besides on Aphrodite herself! Yet even still.

Oi what I said before, 'bout more mortals begetting more suffering and the like? Aphrodite, she reminded me there's more to it than that. And maybe she's right. It's just, I reckon the bad in things is easier to spot...
Now what is {#Emph}that {#Prev}you've got in hand there, let me see! Mayhap another Aspect of some sort, 'cept... {#Emph}augh{#Prev}, not seen anything like that before. I'm proper jealous now!

Like to think I can spot the handiwork of Daedalus, best mortal craftsman ever lived; and I {#Emph}have {#Prev}spotted it! Still keeping busy nowadays, is he? I'm sure even his work leaves bits of room for improvement here and there.
That bit of Adamant you got from me... it's come in handy, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Pure as it gets, too! I hadn't thought you'd end up using it to call on me this much but... I don't mind at all.
Don't want to get involved in all the ugly business with Prometheus and Dad. They won't be sipping Ambrosia anytime soon... but at least nobody's getting livers eaten now.
...You wouldn't know it, witchie, but I'm mad this evening. Nothing you did, mind! Fortunately, when I'm mad, I do good work. My {#Emph}best {#Prev}damn work if I say so myself...
Oi how'd you get there so damn quick, witchie? Mayhap some of your witchie stuff, but I've got something more reliable here just in case.
Got a funny feeling something different's going on, as if... {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, I don't even know! Strange forces are afoot, witchie. Right stranger than the forces gathered here!

Those mortals, they sure got it rough of late. Sometimes I think there's just so blasted many of them now. More suffering and such! {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, reckon that's life! Don't get any say in being born, then do what we can.

Oi, I can't believe old Ares damn near missed the most exciting part of all of this! Showed up in time for Typhon, mind, and now he's showing up for {#Emph}you. {#Prev}Always ends up where the action is.
Haven't the faintest what Hermes is up to. Where is he? Best make hisself useful, else I'm taking back the sandals {#Emph}and {#Prev}the hat! And then we'll see how blasted quick he is!

{#Emph}Ahh{#Prev}, Uncle Poseidon's been of some assistance, then? {#Emph}Heh! {#Prev}Reckon it's more welcome than him stomping uninvited in my forge, all sopping wet, filling the place with steam. {#Emph}Psh. {#Prev}What a kidder!

Ran into mighty Talos, didn't you? Big man all made of bronze. Swore up and down he'd be my best invention yet, but... still got a few kinks need sorting out. Don't bother going easy on him, got to take him apart anyhow...

While back, made your mum and dad bit of a housewarming gift, guess you could say. Scale model of Dad's palace here, for you Underworld lot to remember us by! That Chronos better not have scrapped the thing...

For all these scuffles with Prometheus, reminds me there was once this lass who, after right mean circumstances, accidentally cursed her kind forevermore. Long story long ago, but... I always thought mayhap she cursed us, too.
So you got a bit of metal I could effortlessly bend to my will or something?

Nothing like a good honest fight to settle a family dispute, {#Emph}eh? {#Prev}Especially productive seeing as we can't even kill each other, as old Chronos hisself can attest. {#Emph}Ah well! {#Prev}Plenty of work for me!
Ran into no-eyed Polyphemus, so I hear? Mean bastard, big, all meat and muscle. Could've used {#Emph}that {#Prev}one at the old forge. Ah well! Hope he doesn't try to chew you up or nothing!

Supposedly you're passing through the Mourning Fields along your way down there? Glad {#Emph}I {#Prev}ain't never seen a place like that. Misery's like smoke, gets in your eyes and such... hard to shake off!
You seen that Icarus flying about? At first I took him for some giant ghostly bird, but... it's the kid of Daedalus all right! Reckon he made his latest wings hisself. He's not too bad!

Been living under the auspices of the old Witch of the Crossroads, {#Emph}huh? {#Prev}Not met her face to face. Keeps to herself, so I scarce believed it when Apollo said that she'd reached out with something important. Turns out, it was {#Emph}you!
No charge per usual, I'll just throw it on tab and some point Dad'll pick it up.
Aphrodite's really taken to this warring stuff of late, but she is even happier now that the worst of all the fighting's done. And when {#Emph}she's {#Prev}happy, I am, too. So cheers again, witchie.

Got off on the wrong foot from the first, me and my mum. Can you blame her? Imagine seeing splendorous Apollo and Athena and so on, thinking, {#Emph}oi, I want to make me one of those! {#Prev}But instead, {#Emph}heheheh{#Prev}, you make me.

Never got why some mortals prefer axes with a single blade. Why settle for one? Twice the blades, twice the benefits, I say! No downside. In fact, I've been developing a {#Emph}triple{#Prev}-bladed axe! Still needs a bit of time to bake, but, {#Emph}erm{#Prev}, anyway...
Can't guarantee a weapon worthy of the gods is going to be enough for you to see this through. But I {#Emph}can {#Prev}guarantee you're getting the very best.
Well everybody's all worked up tonight! I've no idea why. Mayhap some witchie stuff only you know about? 'Cause even my Automatons have been behaving bad... worse than usual I mean!

You seen the size of the bloody monster been clambering up our mountainside, witchie? I haven't, thankfully, but... hearing that he's pretty big in size! Typhon hisself! I scarce can keep a steady hand with him about!

See all those Chronos ships trudging this way, witchie? Most of 'em already sunk before, however many times. They and their dead crews keep coming back to haunt us! Now {#Emph}that's {#Prev}some dedicated service, {#Emph}eh?

You and Zagreus been getting on? Known my brother all my life... must be something that you're only just getting to know him now! Try not to fight too much. {#Emph}Heh{#Prev}, but then again, that's what brothers are for!
You bloody did it, then? Whatever {#Emph}it {#Prev}is, everybody here has got their own idea, but... I reckon Typhon's gone and Chronos is touched in the head, so... all in all, not bad.

Chronos must be getting right sore from all your meetings, {#Emph}eh{#Prev}, witchie? But ain't learned a proper lesson yet. Much as it must be nice flattening him, starting to wonder what's the plan here besides that...

My mum and dad, they don't get on too good. But once in a long while, there's a spark between 'em, and they're like a proper king and queen again. The envy of all gods! Lately, though, they're mostly panicking.

For all the times you've been in the area, not seen my forge but once, have you, witchie? That's by design. It's like a bloody vault in here, too many valuables. Including me! Sorry I missed you, mind.

Off to tell your mum and dad the latest after paying us a visit here? Well, may you clobber anybody in your warpath, witchie! 'Specially if it's some other bad Chronos or whatever it is you're doing down there now.
All right then!

2.Text: That I can do.

1.Text: If only we could have met when we weren't in the midst of a war, Lord Hephaestus, but at least I had the opportunity to meet you at all. Your dedication to your craft is an inspiration! I strive to be as skilled at mine.

2.Text: Oi, cheers! Don't know you all too well, and don't like drawing up conclusions till I'm very sure of something, but... you seem a decent enough sort. Much more than can be said for {#Emph}certain {#Prev}members of the family, ain't it?

1.Text: Great Hephaestus! Your work is beyond compare, and I'm grateful for your candor with me as well. Please, take this offering.

2.Text: Anytime I get an offering it's 'cause somebody wants something from me. You're already getting premium service, but hey, it's your Nectar! Well, mine now I reckon.

1.Text: An offering to my great cousin Lord Hephaestus, master of the forge! Such skill and artistry runs in our family, and so much of it with you. And you tolerate such intense heat without so much as a complaint!

2.Text: It does get awful hot here in my forge. Suppose a Nectar ought to cool me off! Not that I ought be drinking at a job like this, but hey! No one's watching, no one needs to know.

1.Text: Lord Hephaestus! Your services must be in very high demand. I'm grateful, and doubtless so are the Nocturnal Arms.

2.Text: Look I don't work for tips. Though ours ain't an ordinary arrangement, and ain't often lately I get new regular clients! So, here. Call it a trade.

1.Text: Hear me, Lord Hephaestus, for this offering of Ambrosia is for you, the hardest-working blacksmith on Olympus or below! Through everything that's happened, you've remained steadfast and calm, and helped me do the same.

2.Text: You think me calm, {#Emph}hah! {#Prev}Inside, witchie, I'm screaming half the time. I just get to pound this metal against that to let the anger vent. Other half the time, I'm feeling pretty good, knowing we found ourselves a decent sort in you.

1.Text: For you, mighty Hephaestus! Though, you may not have occasion for such offerings, working a hot forge every night and day...

2.Text: Oi, this is just a service job, no need to get all cordial and the like. Nice gesture from you, though. So cheers and all.

1.Text: Lord Hephaestus, you're so much more than your ingenious craft. I never could have expected you to be so generous to me, and I'm most grateful for it.

2.Text: Oi witchie, is it hot in here, or are you embarrassing me to no end? Just let me work the blasted forge, no need to make a big deal.

1.Text: I'm in your debt for this, Hephaestus sir.
I'd pick Aphrodite too but... she's expecting me to fight for her, you understand.
My dad's not used to anybody standing up to him, but we can get him there.

HephaestusRejection07.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, don't care for having to retaliate like this, but... it's all part of the deal, you understand.

HephaestusRejection06.Text: You brought this on yourself, witchie! And by {#Emph}this{#Prev}, I mean my favorite hammer here.

HephaestusRejection10.Text: Next I offer you protection, witchie? You'd be wise to take me up on it.

1.Text: Mayhap I'll make me mum real proud if I act spiteful without proper cause!

HephaestusRejection01.Text: Whoever messes with me, they get pounded flat. No exceptions! Not even for {#Emph}you.

HephaestusRejection02.Text: I don't stick up for myself, I'll never hear the end of it. So best ready for the sparks to fly a bit.

1.Text: You'd go warring with my brother over me? Where do you think he gets his gear?

HephaestusRejection04.Text: Push me around, I'm liable to push right back. And I push harder than you might expect...

1.Text: Next time, make Ares mad not me. He's the one wants an excuse to fight!

HephaestusRejection09.Text: You want to see my handiwork, then {#Emph}fine! {#Prev}Might get a wee bit noisy, though.

1.Text: No denying Aphrodite was the fairer choice, but still! Can't let this go unchecked.

HephaestusRejection05.Text: Not going to blow my top... but neither will I take this lying down. Family requirements!

HephaestusRejection03.Text: {#Emph}Eh{#Prev}, much rather keep on hammering this metal over here, but... I can switch over to {#Emph}you {#Prev}instead.

1.Text: Let's {#Emph}flatten {#Prev}'em, witchie!

2.Text: {#Emph}Here's {#Prev}a hammer for you!

1.Text: Sure I don't see why not!

2.Text: I can't turn down a job!

1.Text: The forge-god strikes...!

2.Text: What {#Emph}is {#Prev}that clanging sound?

1.Text: Lord Hephaestus...!

2.Text: Hephaestus, come on!

1.Text: Witchie, I am meeting right now with none other than the Queen herself! And she is saying she would like a word. And I am saying {#Emph}yes Mum, anything you say, go right ahead.

2.Text: You see, my dear? One of the wondrous things about having some children of your own is seeing how obsequious they can become! Go on, Hephaestus. Give her our best.

1.Text: No point in wallowing, witchie! Whatever's going on out there, you got to love what you do, simple as that. Though don't take it from {#Emph}me! {#Prev}Got the authority right here!

2.Text: Why, thank you, dear! We each have so much love to give. And the beauty of it is, the more we give, the more we {#Emph}have! {#Prev}To think that such a {#Emph}precious {#Prev}thing can have a limitless supply!

1.Text: {#Emph}Oi{#Prev}, witchie, was just chatting with {#Emph}Apollo {#Prev}how not all of us are gifted with good looks, and silver tongue, and all. Got to {#Emph}work {#Prev}at something to be good at it! Like he couldn't imagine!

2.Text: Oh, I can more than {#Emph}imagine{#Prev}, Brother. Part of being talented is making things look easy. Take you and blacksmithing! For me it's quite like {#Emph}that{#Prev}, but with a bunch of {#Emph}other {#Prev}things!

1.Text: If I'm supposed to be so good with my hammer, then how come I've yet to make a suit of armor worthy of Aphrodite, eh? Least I got her to pick up a shield. Oi Aphy, you trying something on, or what?

2.Text: Oh Hephaestus, how you worry about me! But I don't like to be weighed down, and would much rather keep my options open than commit to any of these lovely specimens. Why not try our Underworld companion on for size?

1.Text: You can spot the family resemblance between Ares and myself, can you, witchie? Mayhap {#Emph}he {#Prev}got the looks, but {#Emph}I {#Prev}got all the personality, didn't I, Brother?

2.Text: I grant you that we lack the same behavior patterns, Hephaestus. But if there is to be such competition between us, then perhaps Aphrodite herself could be the judge? If you are open to the possibility, of course.

1.Text: My Mum the Queen could not believe that you and I had been conversing lately, witchie. So I had to prove it to her here, you understand. Though seems she wants to be conversing in my stead...

2.Text: My son Hephaestus need only prove he can exude the {#Emph}confidence {#Prev}befitting a god, rather than whatever it is that he exudes instead. He's made himself useful at least, yes?

1.Text: Always grand whenever our Lord Zeus decides to drop by unannounced, and watch over my shoulder whilst I work my forge! Even likes to point where my hammer ought to strike. Well, Dad, where to next?

2.Text: Need I remind you, my good son, that this is not, in fact, {#Emph}your {#Prev}forge, but a facility that all of us may use? And I would use it now to benefit your distant cousin over there! {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, show me how to use this thing again...

1.Text: The mortals, they like giving thanks to us, but what are {#Emph}we {#Prev}supposed to do, you know? Well, I just do the same. Give thanks to Lady Hestia, at least! For keeping my forge burning hot. She even visits me now and again!

2.Text: Well, that's because I {#Emph}like {#Prev}it here, my lad! In spite of all the clanging and whatnot, it's {#Emph}peaceful{#Prev}, more or less. And you're not such bad company to keep. Though, why don't we show your cousin what we can cobble up {#Emph}together?

1.Text: Your grandnan and I, we don't usually get talking very much. But now we got something in common, witchie: {#Emph}you! I {#Prev}say you've got things well under control, but... I can't fool the likes of Lady Demeter!

2.Text: Not one of us has {#Emph}got things well under control{#Prev}, Granddaughter. So pay what Hephaestus said no heed! Instead use our strength combined... and Fates willing, restore for us some sense of normalcy.

1.Text: Proud family, this one! Uncle Poseidon here forgoes full armor on account that he's too quick and too thick-headed, {#Emph}erm... {#Prev}thick-{#Emph}skinned{#Prev}, I mean to say. Ain't that the case, Uncle?

2.Text: Come, Nephew, you know how much I value your craft! Even if I'd not be caught {#Emph}dead {#Prev}wearing much of it myself! It's just, only a {#Emph}coward {#Prev}goes to battle clad in plating head-to-toe; a coward far more likely to withstand his wounds, but {#Emph}still!

1.Text: The blacksmith sigil...
Best learn to take more punishment than {#Emph}that{#Prev}, witchie.

2.Text: Mayhap I'm the runt of the litter, but... I still know how to bite.

3.Text: Careful 'round me, witchie! Lest I tie you in a knot.

4.Text: Don't like what I see, down comes my hammer just like that!

5.Text: I ain't somebody going to let hisself get pushed around again.

1.Text: Time for a tune-up.

2.Text: From the forge.

1.Text: Your Boatman over there? He's one of my best customers, you know! Shows up reliably, knows how to keep his mouth shut, all business, no nonsense.
Mayhap expecting someone else? Or just as likely not expecting anybody in particular, 'cause a blessing is a blessing, ain't that right?
That Gold you used to pay for this... {#Emph}hoh{#Prev}, it's shiny-looking, sure, but... blasted {#Emph}soft {#Prev}as metal goes! Cannot make halfway decent armaments with it, I've tried!
We used to get our Boons to you this way all secret-like, but now we're thinking mayhap there's just something to you getting a surprise! Who doesn't like those? Besides me.
Having to pay for blessings strikes me as a bit {#Emph}crass! {#Prev}The favor of the gods only for the deepest pockets? {#Emph}Oi! {#Prev}You don't even {#Emph}have {#Prev}pockets.
Nobody wants you playing favorites, witchie, so we've got this method of delivering you unmarked Boons where you'll just have to take what you can get. {#Emph}Surprise!
Normally my work fetches a hefty price, but... you're entitled to the family discount! Though Charon there does take a service fee, you understand.
Keep getting shipments of those golden Chronos coins! I melt 'em down, and dump the goop into the Earth whence it came... so Chronos can make more!
{#Emph}Oi{#Prev}, it's only me!

2.Text: Made to order!

1.Text: After such a simple Trial, surely you would attempt another?

2.Text: I have observed all that I wish for now.

3.Text: This facet of reality is clearer to me now.

4.Text: Thus you have proven that this possibility exists.

5.Text: All this was a mere possibility before.

6.Text: I am grateful, though that shall be all for now.

7.Text: This particular experiment was a success.

8.Text: A mere thought, turned into a real possibility.

9.Text: The bounds of what is possible continue to expand.

10.Text: This was a chance I trust was well worth taking.

11.Text: I was sufficiently amused by your attempt.

12.Text: This Trial is complete; I bid you return whence you came.

13.Text: I have observed the outcome of this Trial with keen interest.

14.Text: You may go no further; that is all part of the Trial.

15.Text: I am satisfied with the results of this Trial, and bid you return.

16.Text: You have accomplished what this Trial asked of you.

17.Text: I did not necessarily expect that you would pass this Trial.

18.Text: Another Trial successfully completed, Spawn of Hades.

19.Text: You passed; but now return to shadow, Spawn of Hades.

20.Text: May my Star Dust compensate you for your services.

1.Text: Although you failed this attempt, I was amused.

2.Text: I understand reality can be quite difficult to bear.

4.Text: This outcome was but one of many possibilities.

5.Text: I did not observe as much as I would have liked.

6.Text: An inconclusive result in our experiment.

7.Text: Expected outcomes can be disappointing nonetheless.

8.Text: I do believe the possibility exists that you succeed.

9.Text: This type of failure was a highly probable result.

10.Text: Small variances in your actions led to this.

1.Text: It seems my mark has had an undesirable effect.

2.Text: This is all part of our experiment.

3.Text: I take it this was not the outcome you desired.

4.Text: Thus my mark is washed away, for now.

5.Text: Life is ever-capable of folly, is it not?

1.Text: Whatever this is... it's remarkable, truly.
You can sense my motive in giving you this. Sometimes we simply feel an impulse to express our admiration. Knowing how important your whims are to you, surely you understand.

2.Text: The Olympians often demand tribute from their worshipers, do they not? Their custom, perhaps, but not mine. I merely ask that you honor our arrangement in perpetuity. Though neither shall I reject your offering.

1.Text: Such a strange journey your creations take, Almighty Chaos! This particular bottle, for instance... formed after untold aeons, only to find its way back to {#Emph}you. {#Prev}Inevitably or not.

2.Text: I still possess some of the Nectar that your brother once gave to me, when he was dealing with a certain quandary of his. I think that I shall keep this offering close by to that. You follow in his path, yet seem to choose your own way.

1.Text: I know such sweetness as this Nectar is never to be taken for granted, Almighty Chaos. Please, it's yours! Wondrous creations such as this are only possible because of you.

2.Text: Such gestures are unnecessary to the arrangement between us. If this is an act of supplication, then simply speak your mind. Although I sense no deeper motive presently...

1.Text: Almighty Chaos, I wish to exercise my freedom here by giving you this. Though I suppose you probably could have made it yourself...

2.Text: This Nectar that you offer me is quite an interesting substance. When I created the fabric of reality, I had a sense of the ways in which it could be used; but I did not necessarily anticipate all possible results, including this one.

1.Text: It's heartening to know that the Origin of All Existence also is a source of such limitless curiosity. Here's to finding great interest even in the simplest of things!

2.Text: Substances such as this Nectar... is it not interesting how they can be made, but not unmade? Everything, in essence, is itself. Thus your offering to me is truly unique in its own right. And I thank you for it.

1.Text: Almighty Chaos, please accept the greatest delicacy for which my family is known. I know it's less than nothing in a way; but for us, it's a symbol of the bonds we share.

2.Text: I am unmoved by this Ambrosia that you offer me yet understand this substance is considered valuable and relatively rare. I wonder why you give it to me now, and wish to know; therefore, respond.

3.Text: You seem to like unguarded truth, Almighty Chaos, and it's that I am very much in awe of you. Your attention and your aid mean more than I can say. My family gives Ambrosia when mere words cannot suffice.

4.Text: Your insufficient words have been of greater impact than your gift; I shall accept it all nevertheless. You are amusing, Spawn of Hades, more than I originally thought.

1.Text: {#Emph}Erm... {#Prev}cheers?
If you'll permit me, Almighty Chaos, I wish you to have this gift of Nectar, in accordance with my family's custom among relatives and friends. None of this would have been possible if not for you...

2.Text: Then I shall grant you this wish, and the freedom to bestow upon me further gifts as you see fit. For I have familiarity with this custom of yours, and am prepared to reciprocate.

1.Text: Responsibility is partly mine for all that has transpired.

You recently entered your father's residence within the Underworld's depths, but did not remain there. Did you at least discover what you sought? Do not respond; I am considering all the potential truths.
