The goddess Demeter is set for war, and lends to you her wrathful strength. The mother of your mother has experience fighting Titans... her predecessors. You all have grown so numerous that very little common ground remains.
You have been exploring the surface of this world, where my influence is comparatively limited. I was amused to consider the possibilities, though I did anticipate you would return.
We have eternity to conduct our experiment. I am unconvinced as to whether the results shall come more quickly with the haste of Hermes benefiting you. That is another facet to explore.
I created life, which later gave rise to death; so I can sense how close you are now to the latter state. Even if your godhood means that you can never truly die, it must be quite unpleasant.

You have restored the standing-stone where you reside, and now can see the possibilities within. Should you assist me in exploring my ability to determine outcomes like the Fates themselves, I shall make it worth your while.

I understand the being you call Typhon presents a significant problem for the Olympians, and now also for you. I had not necessarily expected he and Chronos would join forces; perhaps this is why I could not detect Typhon's reawakening.
The Titan you know as Prometheus bestowed on mortals sacred fire from Olympus, in an interesting moment I did not entirely expect. How shall that fire be used hence, and in so many different hands?
Your frequent visits to this space suggest to me my mark is generally to your benefit.
Welcome, Spawn of Hades, to my most-preferred type of experiment.
Spawn of Hades, I have no further wishes to communicate with you this often at this length. I likely shall use fewer words with you henceforth, I think.
There shall always be Darkness here in this space. And I have made it visible to you.
My mark shall be of benefit, once the initial discomfort subsides.
Do you believe the Fates planned for this outcome, or did I?

I sense the Embryo you have of mine has grown to some extent. It shall not come of age for quite some time; but you have nurtured it, and it has been of some small service in exchange. I wonder have you given it a name...?

Some who sought to answer my call turned out to lack the fortitude for the descent. Thus I never call on mortals anymore, and seldom anyone. For Titans and gods can be duplicitous, I know. I ask that you do not betray my trust.
Here in this space, there is a living specimen you may procure. I do not care for it, for there are others of its kind. I gave them ability to replicate, and to find purpose in the act.
What is life, if not a series of unexpected complications?

I am familiar with what you recently achieved, despite Typhon's comparatively different size and strength. How interesting that the smallest beings often prove to be superior; is my conception of strength incorrect?
For your convenience, I have reduced infinite possibilities to three.

I cannot know what it is like to meet one's creator, but you may, and perhaps have. Your father is no longer in his residence, where I sense much has changed. Yet he is not far from there. Perhaps I shall assist you in locating him.
I sensed the growing influence of the goddess Nyx; as though my daughter plunged the world into deeper darkness recently. Yet it was not she who did this; I believe it was you.
You have completed a number of the Trials I have put before you, Spawn of Hades. I would offer you my gratitude, except I thought my Star Dust would be of more use.

Even the goddess Hestia has lent you her power. She typically has been content merely to stoke the little flames warming the hearths of mortal homes. But now those flames threaten to spread beyond even her control.

I am quite interested in control. Once I alone possessed it, until the Fates took some of it from me; then they were gone, after the Titan Chronos had returned. Now they are back. Whose choices have been made...? Everyone's. No one's.
You have a proposition to continue to uphold, O Spawn of Hades.
How interesting that the smallest beings often prove to be superior.
I understand that physical injuries, such as the ones you have sustained, mean little to you gods. Though even gods are able to withstand only so much. Thus, caution is advised.

I understand entering gateways to my domain is not a pleasant sensation, and my mark by its nature yields mixed results. Thus I ask myself why you often venture here; perhaps you merely wish to look upon me thus.
Let us continue our experiment, if you would make your choice.

Recently I found myself unable to detect you much at all, and deduced that you must have completed your forbidden incantation. Thus the surface is laid bare to you. Perhaps I shall ask you to describe it to me sometime.
You bear the Embryo I gave to you. It creates an impression as though a part of me is with you, even whilst you are absent from this space. You may continue to make use of it, or not.

Perhaps I ought to start over again: That is what I think when I observe all that has transpired on the surface of this world. Eventually I expect I shall, though for now, I permit my offspring to continue to multiply and interact as they will.

The act of creation is not always pristine. The residue of it you know as Star Dust, which retains some power over consciousness. Consider it an incentive to look upon the standing-stone and undertake the Trials you see there.

The Trials I devised all begin precisely as planned; but from that point, not even I can influence the outcomes entirely. For instance, I did not expect to find {#Emph}you {#Prev}here, Spawn of Hades.
You are familiar with what you know as the three realms: the heavens, surface, and the Underworld. But I know there to be a fourth, which you are in right now. And Possibility encompasses the rest.

The Fates' designs for us perhaps are intertwined. For we each seek our close kin. I have lost contact with my spawn and daughter, Nyx, who resided in your father's House. Her influence remains, yet I feel her absence...
The Olympians send you their blessings and their messages, having some limited awareness of your circumstances and your whereabouts. So shall it be with me, whilst you are here.
As you have come to me, I shall create in you a temporary change.

The Three Fates are at last returned, and that is well; thus your assistance with my quandary is complete. But as to whether you discovered {#Emph}them {#Prev}or {#Emph}they {#Prev}decided to return remains unclear. They create far more questions now than I.
The being that you know as Typhon is the product of an earlier experiment of mine. I sought for my creations to surprise and multiply, but perhaps not to that extent. And I cannot unmake him now.

You need not venture far to find me, Spawn of Hades. For I am everywhere, particularly where the darkness coalesces into seeming nothingness. Perhaps we shall see each other again when you are closer to your goal.

That daughter of Nyx resembling her mother-goddess is assisting with my quandary, much like you. She is dutiful, but some offspring are not. Perhaps I should have ensured all obeyed; but that would not be quite as interesting.
This world is born of impulse, not of carefully considered plans.

You know the one called Queen Hera of Olympus. She has a certain power over creation, herself. Mortals worship her, begging her favor as they bond and bring their offspring into being. She must enjoy the attention.

The blessing of Hephaestus is upon you. The god of the forge fashions arms and armor fit for war, whilst I created the very things he uses for his trade. No one's work is solely their own, Spawn of Hades.
You may take comfort in the darkness and the silence here.
The Embryo you have of mine: I would see you journey farther with it still. Would you consider the specifics of my thoughts? Respond.

2.Text: If there is something I may do for you, Almighty Chaos, then you need but ask. Where might I take the Embryo?

3.Text: Take it from the beginning of your journey to the end. Do not replace it on the way, but reach your destination with it there; in the Underworld or on the surface, we care not. This shall serve only to amuse the Embryo and me, and perhaps you.

1.Text: Responsibility is partly mine for all that has transpired. I attempted to create this world with a degree of care. I nurtured it; adhered to certain principles, as might a mother and father, for I created {#Emph}them{#Prev}, too. But this world is no longer young. It persists now by its own whim.
You bear the Boon of violent Ares, who often worships me more than his kin; for without creation, there can be no destruction, he says. And I believe he is entirely correct.

The weavings of the Fates are said to bind both mortals and immortals alike. The course and outcome of all lives, all preordained. Thus the sense of choice is merely an illusion. Do you believe this, Spawn of Hades? Respond.

2.Text: I think the Fates determine much about our lives... when and where we are born, for instance, and to whom. But I don't think they set every detail. And, I know they're not weaving at all right now...

3.Text: I see. For the most part, I concur with your assessment. I am the reason Chronos has them now. He asked me where to find them, and I decided to tell him; to verify such choices could be made without their influence. Now do you understand my quandary? Respond...

4.Text: Oh, almighty Chaos, you were deceived. Chronos is different now, but back then wished to find the Fates for his own gain, as one of the forces in this world powerful enough to stop him...

5.Text: Yet they are not so powerful as they appeared. Nevertheless, I think you are correct. Chronos indicated his intentions were benign. I am unfamiliar with deceit, and was misled. I remain quite displeased about this still.

1.Text: Recently the Titan Chronos summoned me, providing many explanations as to why my quandary exists. I did not follow every detail, but observed a different connotation than when last we met, resulting in the disappearance of the Fates. Should I not have accepted his apology? Respond.

2.Text: Almighty Chaos, whether his apology rang true or not isn't for me to say. But I do think the change you heard in Grandfather was a comprehensive one. Can you not work together now to try and find the Fates?

3.Text: The Titan Chronos also volunteered more than I asked. I understand your answer, but am not open to further inquiry. Perhaps the Fates shall be located, or perhaps not.

1.Text: In retrospect, I ought not have permitted Chronos to speak with me, but he was persuasive. I still do not fully understand how you communicate; what you say is not always what you mean, and your intentions may be carefully veiled. So I pay closer notice now.

Recently I ceased to sense the being you call Typhon, which is unusual considering his size. I have been wondering whether this indicates some sort of trouble I am having, or if Typhon merely is no longer there. Which do you think? Respond.

2.Text: The Father of All Monsters is destroyed, Almighty Chaos. It was an action I did not take lightly, but the threat against my family was significant and pervasive. He left us no choice.

3.Text: You could have chosen the destruction of Olympus; nonetheless, I understand why you did not. The power to unmake creations such as that... I would be curious to learn it for myself. Although perhaps I would not use it sparingly.

1.Text: I am aware the goddess of the hunt has lately plied her trade at the boundaries between realms. Artemis was not always so bold; but it is little wonder she was drawn deeper into shadow. You seem to know each other well.
You need not venture far to find me, Spawn of Hades.
When I created life, I had my doubts: Would it invite more problems than it solved? I would be curious to see. Thus my experiment continues to unfold; its outcome, yet uncertain.

2.Text: Almighty Chaos... with your experiment so vast in scope, what can one individual achieve? The quandary you mentioned when first we met... what would you have me do?

3.Text: Spawn of Hades, I ought to clarify I do not care for idle talk. Ask me no questions. Respond only when prompted, or when necessary in absolute. But above all, do as you will.

1.Text: There are no decisions that are not life-changing, Spawn of Hades.

I sensed upheaval in the earth the likes of which I have not felt before; the tenor of it more than the intensity. Something transpired in your father's residence, and Chronos vacated. Why would he take an action such as that? Respond.

2.Text: Respectfully, Almighty Chaos... Chronos has had quite a change of heart. I found my brother Zagreus who aided me in bringing it about. Our grandfather conceded in his war against Olympus, and now seeks to make amends.

3.Text: An interesting change. The absence of detail raises many different questions, which I shall explore. The outcome that you sought has been achieved, yet you seem to pursue it even still. My mark therefore remains available to you.

1.Text: You come from a domain not of the surface nor the Underworld, but between. The caretaker of that domain I have seen occasionally for some time, and serves the goddess Nyx; you are reminiscent of her to me.
I shall hold Chronos to account for what has come to pass. But I am not without blame, myself. For I fear that I made present matters worse. We shall see whether any such mistakes can be corrected.
You bear the blessing of the King of the Olympians himself. I expected that he would have been too preoccupied to be of direct assistance, although he does have a vested interest in your victory...

You traveled far bearing the Embryo I gave to you, which was an interesting matter to observe, and in accordance with the Fates' design. But did they spur your actions, or did you, or I? Further amusement to consider. Thus, thank you.
What sort of Boon is this, in such a place? Well, {#Emph}in the name of Hades! Olympus... {#Prev}are you there...?

2.Text: Olympus cannot hear you, Spawn of Hades. But I can. And I have for you a proposition: Assist with a quandary of mine, and benefit. Your response?
2.Speaker: NPC_Unnamed_01

3.Text: Almighty Chaos...! I'm honored to make your acquaintance. Wh-what sort of quandary would concern the Origin of All Existence...? And, how do I fit in?

4.Text: Time shall tell. But at present, I have inferred that your response, in essence, was affirmative. Thus, may our newly formed arrangement prove most interesting. Accept my mark, and go; and later I shall open the abyss for you again.

1.Text: There was a recent moment when Time briefly ceased to be, and I alone could tell. I believe this coincided with your confrontation with Chronos. Now you return to me, attempting to repeat the same outcome. Interesting.
If you remain here for too long, you shall dissolve into this space; so I suggest you go.
At present, I remain in conversation with the goddess Nyx. My mark is yours as always, but I bid you leave us afterward; though take however long you wish, for we can wait.

You are continuing your journeys to Olympus though the being you called Typhon is no more; for there are battles to be fought as yet, whilst following the footsteps that you made. Is this what Chronos has discovered about Time...?
Reality is what we make of it, O Spawn of Hades; or I, at least.
How shall I reshape your existence this time, Spawn of Hades?

Does there remain a place for beauty and for objects of desire in a world such as this? The goddess Aphrodite must think so, and you work now as allies. I believe it a worthwhile cause; this world was born of a certain desire, after all.
Welcome, Spawn of Hades, to my most-preferred type of experiment. Here, almost nothing is controlled; the possibilities become so numerous, that to consider all of them shall take some time.
I understand your brother has returned. Perhaps he shall come visit me again as once he did. Whichever mark he does not choose, you may receive from me instead.
Your present ailments are not beyond my notice. Perhaps it was unwise of you to visit me within this space whilst you are in such a state. Though I have also made mistakes before.
You are amusing, Spawn of Hades, more than I originally thought.

I anticipated speaking to you thus as you explore the possibilities within the standing-stone. Perhaps you see them as a series of important missions to complete; but they are merely part of our experiment.
You have suffered in your journey to reach me. Perhaps I should reward your struggle; or hasten your likely failure. You shall have to decide.
Respond only when prompted, or when necessary in the absolute.

As you commence your evening's pursuit, you may be best prepared to receive my mark and overcome its undesirable effects. Subsequently you shall have more opportunity to test the limits of the possibilities that it creates.

Once there was Darkness all throughout the Underworld, but now... Chronos works to re-shape the realm to suit his preferences. However, there shall always be Darkness here in this space. And I have made it visible to you.
You remain partial to the Embryo you have of mine, and I would see you journey farther with it still. Would you consider the specifics of my thoughts? Respond.

2.Text: If there is something I may do for you, Almighty Chaos, then you need but ask. Where might I take the Embryo?

3.Text: Take it from the beginning of your journey to the end. Do not replace it on the way, but reach your destination with it there; in the Underworld or on the surface, we care not. This shall serve only to amuse the Embryo and me, and perhaps you.

1.Text: Time, of course, did not always exist. Chronos provided a means of measuring the rate at which everything grew and changed, or did not. He was quite useful by his very nature. But Time can be a source of problems, too, I know.
I trust our arrangement continues to be of interest, Spawn of Hades?

I believe that I am an impartial being, Spawn of Hades. However, even I can be provoked, as Chronos soon shall come to realize. Our experiment concerns his fate; if he believes that he can change his fate, then so may we.
I shall look forward to the outcome of this new endeavor.
Assist with my experiment, and benefit.
We have eternity to conduct our experiment.

I sense a difference now within the Underworld's depths, yet the environment itself is much the same. Those who oppose you still oppose you, so that you may now re-trace some of your steps. This shall result in different outcomes, certainly.
Time appears to be the source of many problems recently.
Recently a daughter of Nyx entered my domain. Such is her likeness that I mistook her for her mother-goddess at first, for many beings appear similar to me. I shall permit her here.
I felt an emptiness that was unusual to me after the goddess Nyx was temporarily taken away. Now that she has returned, that emptiness is mostly gone; especially whilst she is here.
The act of creation is not always pristine.
Your actions yet provide a source of some amusement, Spawn of Hades.
I once created a similar arrangement with a different Spawn of Hades. He was an interesting subject. The interval since last we met grows ever-longer now. Do you know his status? Respond.

Gorgeous, you won the {#Emph}war {#Prev}for us! At least I think we won? Perhaps we didn't if these ugly Satyrs and the like are not about to leave yet, but you definitely did do {#Emph}something! Oh {#Prev}this is all too {#Emph}much!
My, is that some sort of adorable little animal you have with you, gorgeous? Your worshipers come in all shapes and sizes, then! I mostly stick to bewitching gods and mortals, myself.
Last time, you made a real difference here, you know! I shouldn't be surprised, and yet, a single goddess doing so much work? You're quite the inspiration, love! And {#Emph}terrifying{#Prev}, too!

It's been so long, love, why, I felt a little thrill of {#Emph}fright! {#Prev}But then a little birdie told me you'd gone far down in those depths, even to some success? I'll be excited to hear all the juicy bits!
Poor Dionysus has been missing all the fun! Perhaps he thinks the war isn't over yet, what with all the fighting that continues on. He wouldn't believe what happened anyhow!

You know, I mentioned Golden Apples could be turned to Nectar, though not {#Emph}how! {#Prev}I'll have to send the recipe along. All it takes is a boiling pot, some aromatic spices to your taste, and just the right words. You'll get it, you're a witch!
Oh, you bear my Beautiful Mirror! You'll always look gorgeous in it, but its real power is to help me quickly seek you out. And bestow on you the very best I can!

{#Emph}Ooh {#Prev}I just felt a shiver, and not even the {#Emph}good {#Prev}kind, but from thinking of the horrors lurking in the night... it's very dark and sinister out there, so promise me that you'll be careful, love!
A little birdie told me you faced the Sirens at the bottom of the sea? I know them and their entrancing song only too well. They must have grown bored of dooming sailors to the deep!

How nice for Prometheus that he gets to keep venting his anger out on all of us like it's {#Emph}officially {#Prev}his job. How come he thinks we're all so mean to mortals anyhow? I break some hearts, it's true, but fill so many more!
So fiery old Hestia has taken to you, {#Emph}hm? {#Prev}You should be very proud, for typically she can't be bothered. And she cannot be impressed.

Among all of Lord Zeus' kin, you've still yet to encounter Ares, {#Emph}hm? {#Prev}The god of war has been quite busy, what with everything of late. There are those who question his motives, but not I. I long simply to find out where he is.
Back to the comfort of the Underworld for the night? We'll pretty it up in no time!

I'd urge you visit us, though since we're under siege and all, perhaps it isn't worth the trip. Olympus sure takes on a different feel when you're {#Emph}stuck{#Prev}. We've cut back on the feasting and the frolicking a lot. Oh, how I miss those days...
Bright Apollo's been in touch already, {#Emph}hm? {#Prev}How quick to lend fair goddesses a hand. Though, nowhere to be found back when your brother needed aid!
I heard Poseidon boasting he'd already blessed you with his might. Now, just in case one could still be left wanting even after all {#Emph}that{#Prev}, here.

You saw our beautiful Palace grounds again! I'm sorry I missed you but no ugly monsters are ever getting in there if {#Emph}I {#Prev}can help it. Although they {#Emph}have {#Prev}been getting pretty close. They {#Emph}just {#Prev}won't take the hint!

What are we ever going to do about our poor summit? That ugly Typhon made it all the way up here, and he's been ruining {#Emph}everything. {#Prev}Well we are {#Emph}not {#Prev}going to let him walk all over us.

I am {#Emph}so {#Prev}pleased by what you've done for Icarus! {#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, he's been practically over the {#Emph}moon{#Prev}, and who can blame him? He got to truly {#Emph}feel... {#Prev}most mortals aren't so fortunate, let alone most {#Emph}Shades!
One thing's for certain, there's been {#Emph}far {#Prev}too little feasting on Olympus as of late! Poor Dionysus hasn't been himself. Normally he'd be among the first to welcome you!
You know, gorgeous, you're fortunate you got your mother's best! Of course your {#Emph}father {#Prev}always had a certain something, too. Why come to think of it, you're living proof of that!

A little birdie told me you have met none other than the beautiful Narcissus, haven't you? You must think he's a shining example of all I stand for... well, he's not! Because the greatest love is {#Emph}shared{#Prev}, not hoarded for oneself.
So did you try my Nectar recipe, sweetness? I'm certain it'll win over just about anybody in {#Emph}your {#Prev}capable hands. No need to let me know how it goes, I have my ways of finding out!

Have you somebody {#Emph}special {#Prev}in your life? The star pupil of the Witch of the Crossroads must be {#Emph}so {#Prev}terribly busy, why, perhaps the answer is no. So far ahead in some respects, so far behind in others...

You've paid witness to some of Athena's dramatic entrances on the battlefield. I have to say, she isn't bad in that regard! Probably because she's having so much practice with all of our unwelcome visitors!
Whoever's on {#Emph}your {#Prev}bad side, love, they're on {#Emph}mine {#Prev}as well.
You witches can be {#Emph}such {#Prev}elusive sorts, though I know {#Emph}just {#Prev}where to find you!
Hold it right there, sweetness! You're not about to head into the dark of night without my aid, to help keep you {#Emph}warm and tingly{#Prev}, and our foes {#Emph}dead and buried!
Even in bad times, we can find {#Emph}something {#Prev}to love!

It can't be pleasant, crawling through the Underworld's underbelly night after night. But, there's beauty to be found in all things! Well, {#Emph}most {#Prev}things. Down where you are, no guarantees.
We goddesses always get swept up in these family affairs through no fault of our own. {#Emph}I {#Prev}had no prior qualm with Chronos, yet here I am now, well at war with him!
{#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, beautiful, you're {#Emph}hurt! {#Prev}How unforgivable. Whoever dared, I trust you ended their existence painfully!
I've always been something of a fighter, as Lord Ares here knows. But I keep telling him, the great conquests of love are more thrilling than the great conquests of war!

2.Text: I do enjoy a good protracted fight, my Lady Aphrodite. To me, conquest is conquest; whether on the battlefield or in the heart, it matters not. And I find all of it quite moving.

1.Text: I used to think your Lord Uncle Poseidon was a rude and useless oaf... but, after having seen his fighting prowess in this war firsthand, I've come to realize how wrong I was! He isn't useless in the least!

2.Text: Why thank you, Aphrodite! For I know how challenging it is for you to fathom the totality of my strength, as let's face it, you're not exactly the goddess of wisdom! {#Emph}Nor am I! {#Prev}And we have other common ground, in the {#Emph}beauty of the sea!

1.Text: You and your Granny Demeter, you must have {#Emph}so {#Prev}much catching up to do! Perhaps you even have the power to un-freeze that disapproving scowl I oft fear is {#Emph}permanently {#Prev}set, though... I can see she wishes to address you now herself!

2.Text: Please pay no heed to Aphrodite, flower. She's more concerned about the contours of my face than doing anything of use. But on the count that we've much catching up to do, she's right...

1.Text: To win somebody's heart, we have to fight! And we can break somebody's heart that way as well. Lord Ares here knows {#Emph}all {#Prev}about the way it works.

2.Text: Oh that I do, and I am grateful for your teachings, Lady Aphrodite; my own knowledge had been woefully incomplete, until you expressed your willingness to share yours.

1.Text: The fleeting quality of beauty is what makes us {#Emph}long {#Prev}for it! But even for those whose {#Emph}outer {#Prev}beauty has abandoned them, there's oft an {#Emph}inner {#Prev}beauty that burns bright! Don't you agree, dear Hestia?

2.Text: Careful with that line of reasoning there, Aphrodite. You don't have much inner beauty to speak of, and your {#Emph}outer {#Prev}beauty I can melt off in a {#Emph}snap. {#Prev}And growing all those lustrous tresses back would take a while, by my reckoning...

1.Text: It pains me to admit there are occasions when love is not the answer, and a bit of sharpened metal can much sooner do the trick. In such matters, my Hephaestus can be of assistance, can't you, dear?

2.Text: For you, Aph? {#Emph}Anytime. {#Prev}And as for witchie here, {#Emph}most {#Prev}of the time! Now come {#Emph}on. {#Prev}Even when the situation calls for sharpened metal, you know how to get the point across!

1.Text: We have to defend the things we love, don't we, sweetness? Or else we might just lose them. Fortunately, I have the best protection one could ever ask for, right here.

2.Text: Think she's referring to my armor, witchie! Just in the middle of a fitting, thinking oi, we know somebody what could use an extra bit of padding where it counts! So, here!

1.Text: Be on your {#Emph}best {#Prev}behavior now, gorgeous! For I present to you our most resplendent Queen. No stranger to the ways of war, or to extinguishing the wretchedness that festers in the hearts of the wicked! Behold, {#Emph}our Lady Hera!

2.Text: I think we're past the need for such pomp, Aphrodite. But then, more goddesses ought better understand the need to keep appearances even in troubled times... {#Emph}especially {#Prev}in troubled times.

1.Text: Love binds us all together, and inspires us to feats we never could accomplish on our own! And don't just take {#Emph}my {#Prev}word for it, gorgeous. Your {#Emph}wise {#Prev}and {#Emph}even-handed {#Prev}uncle... he knows all about spreading the love around!

2.Text: You're most correct, dear Aphrodite, for my rule is based on love of family and of mortalkind as well. What are we fighting for, if not a way of life in which our passions are the driving force?

1.Text: There's so much beauty on Olympus, love! Take {#Emph}me{#Prev}, for instance, or bright Apollo, {#Emph}hm? {#Prev}Your cousin, is he not? I daresay I see a hint of resemblance!

2.Text: Now that you mention it, Lady Aphrodite, these flaxen locks of mine are a little bit akin to the pale luster of my cousin's flowing mane. There must be so much beauty in her realm, as well!

1.Text: Mm-{#Emph}hmm!

2.Text: My pleasure.

1.Text: I can't say no to such a lovely gift.

Aphrodite, your genuine enthusiasm even in the face of such hardship is so much of what makes you beautiful and inspirational beyond compare. I feel as though Ambrosia such as this symbolizes all the love you have to give.

2.Text: {#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, you're {#Emph}so {#Prev}very kind! Though it never gets old. I'm {#Emph}used {#Prev}to everybody fawning over my {#Emph}looks! {#Prev}But if you can see past that, the {#Emph}inner beauty {#Prev}I possess, then you know {#Emph}far {#Prev}more of love and beauty than {#Emph}most.

1.Text: Great Aphrodite! You must get more offerings than all the other gods and goddesses combined. Though, this one comes from me!

2.Text: Why, this is {#Emph}wonderful{#Prev}, and also quite impressive you already know our ways! I {#Emph}must {#Prev}return the gesture, so please, take {#Emph}this. {#Prev}I {#Emph}insist!

1.Text: I know so little still of matters of the heart. There's surely so much I could learn from you, Lady Aphrodite. I'm honored to have met.

2.Text: Oh, sweetness, the honor is {#Emph}all {#Prev}mine! For matters of the heart, the key is openness. So you're well on your way towards the understanding you desire!

1.Text: Your favor means so much to me, Lady Aphrodite. If only I could return it somehow! Even during the most difficult of times, you bring me strength and hope.

2.Text: My heart, you're {#Emph}truly {#Prev}something, you know that? You're generous, selective with your words, and {#Emph}gorgeous{#Prev}, too! I don't know whether to be flattered or a little envious!

1.Text: Glorious Aphrodite! You are truly stunning, yet your courage and confidence inspire me still more. I'm humbled to be in your presence, and to be worthy of your favor.

2.Text: I didn't know what to expect from you. A sister-in-arms, at best? And I scarcely know you, save for glimpses from these messages, but despite all that... I've come to think of you as a friend! Someone to talk to. Thank you, love!

1.Text: You make me want to doubt myself less frequently, Lady Aphrodite. You wouldn't mind another offering, would you?

2.Text: Your offering is {#Emph}more {#Prev}than welcome, love! And come to think, it's been entirely too long since someone showered me with praise!

1.Text: I've always thought the world beautiful... it's everywhere around us, even in times of strife. And I know that's because of {#Emph}you{#Prev}, Aphrodite. Thank you for helping me perceive it all.

2.Text: From you, this Nectar surely shall be sweeter than the rest! So when the clouds begin to darken overhead, and I feel my hope begin to wane, I'll drink to us. And I shall bounce right back!

1.Text: You {#Emph}could {#Prev}stay out of these infrequent little spats I have with my hard-working Hephaestus. But if you {#Emph}really {#Prev}want to get involved, why, {#Emph}sure!

AphroditeRejection02.Text: Oh, gorgeous. If pride and vanity are truly weaknesses, then I'm about to let myself be very vulnerable with you here...

AphroditeRejection04.Text: I don't offer you my blessings so you can just save them for later like some sort of snack! You want something else, fine! You can {#Emph}have {#Prev}it.

AphroditeRejection11.Text: I'm really not accustomed to rejection, and shall {#Emph}not {#Prev}get used to it because of {#Emph}you!

AphroditeRejection01.Text: Our world can be such an ugly place! Filled with such terrible misunderstandings as can veil the beauty we so often {#Emph}don't appreciate enough.

AphroditeRejection07.Text: Oh, don't be such a {#Emph}tease {#Prev}with me! When I bestow my blessings, take them graciously next time. But now...?

AphroditeRejection05.Text: Try as I might, I just can't help but feel the sting of being spurned. And I don't like it, not a little bit. So now I have to sting you back!

1.Text: You'd side with dear Hephaestus over {#Emph}me? {#Prev}There must be some mistake, sweetness! Which means there too must be some sort of {#Emph}punishment...

AphroditeRejection06.Text: There may be those who can make peace with being brushed aside, but that's not something {#Emph}I {#Prev}can do, sweetness! No matter how hard I try.

AphroditeRejection08.Text: Sometimes I think we shouldn't force you to play favorites, but we shouldn't do a lot of things, I'm sure! Such as get angry with {#Emph}you!

1.Text: Age before beauty, is that it? For I can think of no other explanation for what you've done!

AphroditeRejection03.Text: I truly thought we ladies had a special connection, but then you do such things and make me feel unsure! And just a bit upset.

1.Text: They're going to love {#Emph}this!

2.Text: I'm here for you, gorgeous!

6.Text: It'll be a thing of beauty!

1.Text: Anything for {#Emph}you{#Prev}, love!

2.Text: Who do you think you {#Emph}are?

1.Text: I would {#Emph}love {#Prev}for you to {#Emph}leave!

2.Text: I am not so {#Emph}easily {#Prev}distracted.

1.Text: Lady Aphrodite...!

Were you expecting someone far less beautiful, or did you somehow know it was {#Emph}me? {#Prev}Perhaps you could hear my heart beating all the way from where {#Emph}you {#Prev}are!
You have a real understanding with that Boatman, haven't you? He's such a solitary soul. Rugged... tall... powerfully built. {#Emph}Hm!
{#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, to be an urgent bit of battlefield relief delivered courtesy of the feared Boatman himself, {#Emph}hah! {#Prev}Come on, we all have fantasies, gorgeous!
I wanted this to be a surprise, love! Who could possibly ask for a better outcome opening up some plain old bag, only to find {#Emph}me {#Prev}waiting there with outstretched arms?
Trusty Charon reached you after all, and just in time to face the gravest threats along your path. So may my blessing bring you victory!

Your Boatman there has such an {#Emph}ugly {#Prev}job, having to smuggle little blessings such as these into the {#Emph}worst {#Prev}of places... but we make it worth his while, don't you worry about that.
Well, well!

2.Text: {#Emph}Ah, ha-hah!

1.Text: Good news is we can now be sure what Gramps had planned for us, but bad news is, it's Typhon, and he's big. But my pop stopped him once, so how hard could it be...?
Live fast or not at all, right, M? Now take your pick!
You found my special Shrines, good good! Some mortals pray to me both for safe travels and free stuff. {#Emph}Almost {#Prev}free. Small surcharge, mind! Associate has got to take his cut.

We really got him, M! Typhon, that is! I saw him tumble down the dark side of the mountain to the bottom and go {#Emph}boom! {#Prev}Then later saw him slowly get back up, and roar more angrily than ever, but hey!
The sooner we get this done, the sooner we get to the next, and on, and on!
Olympus has been under siege before! Normally, it's not too big a deal. But Gramps has something else in mind this time. Got some individuals here pretty spooked!
Been good to see you and Artemis out and about a little more! She's got a mean bow but she can always use somebody out there drawing all the attention so she can line up her shots!

Nice snake-staff that you've got there, M, must be they're all the rage! These snakes of {#Emph}mine {#Prev}are from Apollo, helps remind me of the family, you know? Stuck together, skin not so thick, pitch hissy-fits sometimes... love 'em anyway.
This is a proper spooky night, you had something to do with it, right M? My heart's racing nonstop! Whatever you've been up to in your Crossroads there, hope it works!

Officially, I'm keeping tabs on you, you're not supposed to know, just so you know. I tell Olympus {#Emph}all {#Prev}the latest happenings, nothing too private, mind; and then I tell {#Emph}you {#Prev}more! Just keeping tabs on everyone I guess!

Typhon is gone for good?! My pop, he can't believe it still, but there has been no sign of that monstrosity up here since you last took him on! But why am {#Emph}I {#Prev}surprised? I figured if anyone could pull something like that off, it would be {#Emph}you!

Something that scares me, M, is the idea that Time may be even quicker than {#Emph}I {#Prev}am. Remember back when you were real small! Well {#Emph}bam! {#Prev}You're {#Emph}old {#Prev}now, just like {#Emph}that!
Hey hey, M! One of those heys is from Artemis.
Nice night for a little jog, wouldn't you say there, M?

You'd think the Titan of Time wouldn't be so stuck in the past, caught up in his idea of a {#Emph}Golden Age {#Prev}when {#Emph}he {#Prev}used to rule, and mortals hadn't a care in the world? Caring's not such a bad thing I think!
M, I would never mean to slow you down, especially as you get started for the night! So you go on and pick something, and then get {#Emph}out {#Prev}of there!
What a coincidence, it's you, and you're {#Emph}already {#Prev}quick! But you can always be a little quicker! Not me, though.
Somebody call for Premium Express delivery, hey, M? This is the {#Emph}best {#Prev}I've got, and it'll take you far and fast! You have my {#Emph}guarantee!
You found your father down there, M! Never could get close enough myself, hope he's still all right. Hope {#Emph}everyone{#Prev}'s all right! We'll get them back, keep doing everything we can.
Fresh from the highest peaks of Olympus, it's the {#Emph}Premium Express! {#Prev}The finest, fastest blessings, for only the most discerning customers. That's {#Emph}you!
You got Hephaestus to come out of his shell! All I can get from him are work orders, {#Emph}bring me more bronze {#Prev}and such! Glad you can put the fruits of all his labor to good use!
{#Emph}Special delivery for the Princess of the Underworld!

Some of the gods think Eris showed up near our mountain causing trouble again all because of you! They don't know I practically {#Emph}begged {#Prev}you to come up to our rescue over here. Think Hec gave you the order! We're really in it now...
Got to check up on a couple of things, but first, here!

Guess what, last night, you made it to the end in record time, {#Emph}again! {#Prev}Keep getting faster like that and you'll soon be giving {#Emph}me {#Prev}a run for it, though I won't stand for that, you hear me, M?
Known Hec a while, and don't envy either one of you. She couldn't just send you off to deal with Gramps before you were ready! You must have {#Emph}hated {#Prev}having to wait. I know I do!
We've got more Titan problems than we figured, M. If Gramps could get Prometheus to take his side, who only knows what else. Ruffled a lot of feathers haven't we?

At least the family knows about you now! Always wanted to say, {#Emph}Message to Olympus! Persephone and Hades had another kid! And she's all right! {#Prev}But Hec knew we had to wait, and she knows a lot! So my lips were sealed.
Had enough surface air for now, I get it, M. The more familiar path is often best! Either way, take this at your own pace. Don't anybody rush you! Except me.
New moon, which means Selene gets a break, but you know who does not?

Artemis and I weren't always close, each keeping to ourselves and all. But working with you and Hec brought us closer! We were so busy sneaking around, helped knowing we didn't have to sneak around each other!
Met Ares did you, M? Whenever there's a bloody dust-up, tempers flaring and all that, he will do everything he can to draw it out! This must be quite a big dilemma for him, mind.

You found them, M! The Fates! They told me so themselves, figured I'd spread the word, being a messenger and all, and you know what? They're {#Emph}right! {#Prev}Sounds like their time away gave them a change of heart...
Oh good! Selene got a hold of you already, M! Quite the vantage point the Eye of Night has got! Always looking out for you and all of us. Her steeds are pretty quick as well!
Ran into big old Heracles, did you? My stepmum's sent him on another labor of some sort. Got the feeling that his heart's not in it anymore. But hey, he's tough! And we could use the help.
Things don't look great right now, but that can quickly change!
No calamitous attack on our family is going to slow us down!

So far I'm liking this new Gramps of ours {#Emph}much {#Prev}better than the mean old Chronos from before. You'll have to tell me sometime how you turned his world upside down to make him be this way. Hec hasn't said a thing!

Keeping track of your best time, that's what I like to see! Take anything worth doing, then do it just as well a little faster, and a {#Emph}little {#Prev}faster, and soon, you'll be like {#Emph}me! Almost!
Well you are moving awful quick, and sure enough, you've got that Droplet from me there! You must be real used to it, and it'll keep delivering night after night, you've got my guarantee!

Something's odd about tonight though can't exactly put my finger on it, M. Though Hec says that lately you've been messing with the Pitch-Black Stone of yours, which always made me feel a bit like {#Emph}this!
Looks like you hit a few bumps on your way there, M! Do watch your step, though when you're moving fast, I know it can be tough!
Got something I think you can use, and a couple others just in case!
Only the best and swiftest service for my valued customers!

All this reminds of the time I backed your brother when he was searching for your mum! Had a vested interest in the outcome, sure. But before I knew it, I really started to care! We'll find a way to help them, won't we, M?
Now take a moment to decide here M, but don't take more than that!

Hephaestus makes a {#Emph}mean {#Prev}set of armor, and you know what? He makes a mean pair of sandals, too. I wear mine all the time! {#Emph}Footwear{#Prev}, M! I really think it's going to catch on!
We'll have you on your way in no time at all!
Time of need here, M, and we need you at the bottom of the Underworld, {#Emph}and {#Prev}the top of Olympus! Two places at once, my sympathies. The {#Emph}trick {#Prev}is to move really, really fast!

To think I used to fill my days with whisking mortal newly-deads down to your father's realm! Honestly grew to like it soon enough, so even after Gramps showed up, I kept on stopping in when I could sneak a trip!
Oh great, you're headed up this way and not gone too far yet! Think you could make good time on your way here, although the choice is yours!
You finally saw what it was like up here! Most of the others are holding out at the top of Olympus, and {#Emph}you {#Prev}are the reinforcements. So, come on back when you can, all right?

Hey, you made it to the finish line faster than ever last time! I may be keeping tabs, it's what I do, and maybe you won't {#Emph}always {#Prev}beat your best, but when it happens, it has {#Emph}got {#Prev}to feel good!
Hey! Got one of those special deliveries for you, M!
Choose quickly M, {#Emph}or else! {#Prev}Or else I'll wait. But I would rather not!
Message from Olympus, M! It says {#Emph}Cheers for all the backup lately, since we know you could be down in Tartarus fighting with Gramps instead. {#Prev}Athena's words, not mine!
You made it pretty far down there before! Impressive work, I knew you had it in you, M! But Gramps still isn't backing down, is he? Maybe he's having second thoughts at least!

Hec always said you're quick to learn, you know? And sure enough, whenever I'd drop in, you'd be over a cauldron, working some new spell. Well, {#Emph}this is it! {#Prev}Your time to work some magick for our sake!
{#Emph}Hurry, M, before it's too late! {#Prev}I like saying that.
You're taking something of a scenic route down to your father's House! Gramps has the major regions of the Underworld locked down, so... come to think, that makes a lot of sense!
It's rough out there tonight, isn't it M? Well just hang on, and maybe one of {#Emph}these {#Prev}will help you go a little farther, {#Emph}faster!
No way you could have already stopped Gramps by now, but going after him right when you did, you're buying us some time to put a little wrinkle in his plan. So {#Emph}cheers!
Ran into Lady Circe on your way last night, did you, M? She's quite the talent with those magick spells of hers. Liked turning mortals to all sorts of things! Bit {#Emph}mean {#Prev}if you ask me!

All right, so it's rough going on the surface for you, I get that, but don't give up on us yet, M. I know you {#Emph}never {#Prev}would, mind. Probably just searching for some magickal ingredients you need, something like that?
Sure, Time goes fast! But I think we'll be able to keep up!
Thought I'd catch you right on your way out! Travel can be a very rewarding experience, but sometimes, you just want to get to where you need to be!

Your mum would travel back and forth between Olympus and your father's House, and {#Emph}I {#Prev}had the pleasure of accompanying her! One day, she didn't show up. I knew right then and there something was off...
Hey hey, M! One of those heys is from Selene.
Both got some business to attend to, so let's get you on your way!
You headed up this way? Maybe I'll see you later on!
You know, I think my stepmum likes you quite a bit! Not to be taken for granted! Despite her specialties, I get the feeling our Queen Hera's not too keen on kids.
Hey M, you need a lift? 'Cause I've got one. Three, in fact!
We're in a race against Time, and so help me, we are going to win!

For all that's happened, glad you finally met Demeter, even if only by Boon. She had a funny way of showing it sometimes but {#Emph}always {#Prev}loved your mum an awful lot. She'll fight to get her back, to the bitter end.

What a customer, the Titan of Time! I've not met Gramps before, though I can imagine what he must be like. Used to wonder how come my pop and his brothers were so dodgy sometimes. Now I know where they got it from!

Some sort of new age is in store then, take it you heard all about that firsthand, M. Guess it'll be here before we know it, as things like that tend to go! We'll be ready, and even if not, we'll act fast.

The Fates supposedly are no longer deciding what'll happen from here out? Except big stuff, like new ages and such? Don't know {#Emph}how {#Prev}we're supposed to tell the difference, whether everything is planned by {#Emph}them {#Prev}or ours to decide...
Coincidentally was passing through with choice of blessings here!
Got another mean old Chronos to take care of so don't let me keep you, M!
All right, M, let's give {#Emph}you {#Prev}a little boost!
Athena's out there managing frontline defensive strategies and such. We mostly stay out of each other's way. She keeps her head in times like these, I'll give her that!
Found you quick so you have got the whole rest of the night to hurry up!
I know it was Apollo you expected, M, and he's quick! But I am quicker, and could beat him getting to you {#Emph}every time {#Prev}if I was a bit pettier than this! He'll be right with you soon.
The dead throughout Ephyra should be resting easy in your father's care, but Gramps shut it all down, flung open the Underworld's gates, and here we are. If I were dead, I'd be mad, too.
Used to always want you on the surface although lately I don't mind it either way!
Don't keep me waiting, M, unless you want to kill me, in which case we can't be friends!
Last night marks one more mean old Chronos down I guess! Sounds like we've got a lot of them to go through, though I'm sure we'll start taking care of them faster and faster!
The busier we are, the more we do, and the faster the time goes by!
Don't just want to be quick, {#Emph}be {#Prev}quick! Including when you choose!
Thought I'd check up on you, everything good? Then good!
Think you can take out Typhon just like last time, M?

Still have the matter of the Three Fates to be sorted out. So Gramps just sent them into exile and then entirely lost track? How are {#Emph}we {#Prev}supposed to find them if {#Emph}he {#Prev}can't...?
It's been a busy night though I will always make the stop for you!
Hec tells me Moros, son of Nyx, is staying with you for a bit down there? I thought he always stuck with the Three Fates. There's something going on, and I don't like it, M.

You sure are a good customer to my professional associate, or so I'm hearing, M! I'm mostly hearing {#Emph}hrrrrnggh{#Prev}, mind, but I've seen how many of his Gold Rewards you're racking up, and it {#Emph}is {#Prev}quite a lot!
Let's keep the pace up and get rid of every last bad possibility!
Heard from my pop tonight already, M? He's always been a very busy god but never tires out. Now that you've got his lightning strength, how about some lightning {#Emph}speed {#Prev}to boot?
Lots going on! Been running around all night!

Hey M! Don't know exactly what you did, or maybe Hec, but you seem much much more yourself than last I saw. That's great! Because to make it all this way, you're going to need {#Emph}every {#Prev}bit of strength. And {#Emph}speed!

Prometheus and Heracles, turns out they're close, are they? Your little spat with them was shrouded by the dark but I caught glimpses of it here and there. I need to know about these things though doesn't mean I'll tell!

No surprise old Gramps is a tough customer, but sorry he got you last night. And cheers for heading up {#Emph}this {#Prev}way! {#Emph}Time {#Prev}isn't going anywhere just yet, but this mountain might!
Want to make haste, then I got just the thing!

That wasn't Gramps himself you dealt with last night, but some sort of fluke of possibility that happened all because of how you dealt with him in the first place? I've seen a lot of things, M, but this is a first!
Uncle Poseidon's blessing done you any favors yet this eve? Likes claiming it'll make you nigh invincible, but here's a little traveler's insurance just in case!
Oh hey! Thought I'd stop by, drop off a little something for you here!
So Hestia already got you, then? She's really rather spry despite her age. And likes to play with fire, too! Still just a kid at heart... one of those wee scary ones, mind!

These last few nights since you got started, all I managed to confirm is Gramps got hold of someone whom he's sure gives him the upper hand. Right now he's readying the next stage of his plan to bring this mountain down! I'd better go.
Looks like we've got another busy eve ahead of us!
Don't think too much about this now, just snap one up and go!
So the Boatman's been all right, has he? That's good! I know that he's been looking out for Hec and the rest of you for a while now, but do look out for him in turn, would you?

You almost made it to the very top that time, and though it's not my wish to spoil the surprise, you {#Emph}ought {#Prev}to know we're dealing now with good old Typhon, Father of All Monsters! Isn't that just great...? We need you back here, M.
Sure, the worst of our problems are over for now, but why slow down?
They say to not be hasty, but then what do they know, right?
I'm scraping by. You scraping by? Let's scrape on by, why not?
In a bit of a rush, here, M, so let's get moving shall we?

I'd say I can't believe you did it, M, but that would mean I didn't think you could, but I {#Emph}did{#Prev}, so I {#Emph}won't! {#Prev}But I {#Emph}will {#Prev}say: Cheers for {#Emph}everything! {#Prev}I know we might not be completely done, but if a bit of pressure's off now, good.
However many Typhon possibilities are left, let's make one less!
Oh, no! You're hurt! What happened to you, M? Gramps must have got to you before I did! How is that even possible...?
I like to talk sometimes but I like going quickly {#Emph}always {#Prev}so how about we keep these little conversations nice and brief from here? For the most part!
Who do you think can make it to the top of Mount Olympus first, M, you or old Typhon? You've got a longer way to go, sure, but you are definitely faster! Or about to be!
I wouldn't have believed you're going after the remains of Typhon had I not seen the whole thing for myself! Time works in strange ways! And looks like you can put a stop to it after all. Some of it!
Wise move having an animal companion along! I've got a soft spot for the quiet self-sufficient types. My little tortoise Chellen always feels at home wherever we go!
Time sure is strange, don't you think, M? No surprise not even Gramps entirely understands it himself. I just don't like it when Time drags on for too long, so {#Emph}let's move!
Another night, another Typhon down, but there are plenty more where he came from, is that your understanding, M? Glad those Typhons haven't been a problem for us here!
Quick and quiet, M! You've got this, right?
Hec says you're getting closer to a breakthrough there, with Gramps and Typhon and whatnot. Don't want to rush you, M, but this is {#Emph}me! {#Prev}I just can't help myself sometimes.
I've got a lot of regulars, but just between us, {#Emph}this {#Prev}one is my favorite, M. You Underworld types tend not to be too fussy, and you're clear with what you want. I like that about you!
You're moving right along there, M! Helps having that Metallic Droplet with you at all times. At least till it stops working for the night! Can't go top speed forever, but {#Emph}we try!
Had a feeling that I'd find you here one of these nights, you know? Like something's in the air. I'm all keyed up, just want to get things done as {#Emph}mega{#Prev}-fast as possible!
Notice you're not timing yourself anymore, and M? It breaks my heart. Not really, mind. Just find your speed, but still! Want to know how fast you are, there's only one way to find out.
Gramps sends forces to Olympus, we can send them whence they came, no sweat. But he's got something else in store, and whatever it is, it's big. Learn anything, let Hec know right away.
You've never been one to back down from anything, huh, M. Well then that Oath of the Unseen is {#Emph}everything {#Prev}you ever wanted probably! Why go easy, when you could go hard?
You showed old Gramps who's boss! {#Emph}Good going, M! {#Prev}That ought to trip him up a bit. Fine time to come on up and help us drive his forces off {#Emph}our {#Prev}turf. What do you say?

One of these nights, maybe you could teach your brother how you breathe up here so he could pay us all a visit too? Eventually, I mean, after we're finished cleaning up for Gramps. The family always wanted Zag to stop on by.
You made it up here, M! I'll speed you on except this climate's going to be {#Emph}rough. {#Prev}You Underworld types and surface air! Must be something we can do about it, right...?
You run into a certain Underworld Boatman rowing about, you tell him I said hey? We've not collaborated much as before, what with everything of late. I miss those times!
That's not the safest place to travel, is it, M? So you picked up a scrape or two, so what! Now you'll pick up some speed!
You already caught up with Artemis, good good! She and I don't always chat, running around a lot, being discreet and all. But we exchange a knowing look from time to time!
This time I've got my very best for you to choose from, M, though you should {#Emph}always {#Prev}expect quality from me! I just have even more of it than usual right now!
Hey, hear that, M? Why, that's the sound of {#Emph}Premium Express delivery{#Prev}! Always bringing {#Emph}you {#Prev}only the very best. So, make the most of it?

Some of our relatives don't like to get involved. Dionysus, he will go to every feast, but never to a fight! {#Emph}Why don't we all just get along{#Prev}, he says. Though, come to think... it's not a bad idea!
Aphrodite's blessing on you, M? Impressive work, her graces are in {#Emph}very {#Prev}high demand! Much as she likes getting involved in personal affairs, yours surely is a special case!
Another race to the finish line begins, hey, M? Well then, {#Emph}get set{#Prev}, because we'll have you there in no time flat! Provided you survive and all...
Figured you were due to get there right about now!
Apollo's lighting up your life? Last thing he ever wants to do is get his hands dirty, but now, things being as they are, he doesn't have much of a choice I guess!
Hey M! Heard you were heading out again, figured I'd drop on in, and send you off! Safe travels, and all that!
I know you can't breathe in our surface air forever, M, so it's a good thing I got a hold of you right as you're starting off! We'll get you to this mountaintop in practically no time.

If only I could whisk you clear across the sea-rift that Poseidon carved out. But we {#Emph}mustn't {#Prev}get spotted working too closely together. And besides, you're helping us with every deck you swab! So {#Emph}cheers!

Hey M! You're here! That's great! Hec says you even got your Underworld blood-curse sorted so you're ready for a bit of a long-distance run. Just watch for bumps along the way, though let's speed you past them if we can!
You saw we stashed some goods for you up on our mountaintop, right M? It's just a bit out of the way for my professional associate, though we'll keep you supplied!

Hec says you spoke the Oath of the Unseen, so then I guess we're in for it, right M? The others might not know what's going on, it's just another eerie night, but you do what you have to do. Night's will be done and all.

So Gramps somehow got hold of the Three Fates! That isn't good, not sure what we can do about it, M. At least now everybody on Olympus knows, I figured it was time! Got us a bit on edge, though we do hide it pretty well!
Thought you could sneak on out of there without me giving you my Boon, well you're entirely mistaken, M! And you're about to be much quicker, too!
Saw your brother's back and doing well, that's great! Always was a tough sort, I figured he'd pull through. Who knows, maybe some evening he'll get {#Emph}you {#Prev}out of a bind!
Got something here should put a real spring in your step!
Cheers again for the Ambrosia, M. Not been much time for it though my professional associate and I managed to share a bottle recently. Short break, mind, but just what I needed!
You're really helping tip the scales here! Broke through the siege and gave our relatives a minute of reprieve. Still isn't over, mind, but we can get there soon enough I think!
That Cyclops waiting as you're heading out of town? Been there a while, thought eventually he would move on, but he did not! Gramps must have put him up to this...
Your father's back where he belongs, your mother too, I'm really glad they're safe and sound together, M. You've got to make up for lost time with them, and you'll be able to from here on out!

M, I know it's not an easy trip, or even possible for you right now, heading all the way up here. But just imagine how hard it is for our family to swallow our pride and ask for aid! Things are that grim!

Message from Olympus, M! It says {#Emph}How come you're toiling about the Underworld? We sure could use you way up here, it's just we're way too proud to ask! {#Prev}But {#Emph}I {#Prev}am not too proud.
Long way to go from there, right, M? Well let's see if we can't cut out a little travel time to your next destination!

To our esteemed Messenger, and my distinguished friend! Not only have you kept the bond between the Underworld and Olympus from fraying, you've done it swiftly and silently. You're practically a chthonic god yourself!

2.Text: That really means a lot, cheers, M. You know I like doing things fast, but the one thing I like even {#Emph}more {#Prev}is doing things well. We gods don't always have to work hard, but your father always did, and so do you. I'm glad I'm not alone.

1.Text: To the swiftest of the gods, and one of my dearest, oldest comrades. Lord Hermes, you've served both Olympus and the Underworld, and you've seen it all. The rest of our family can learn so much from you. I know I could.

2.Text: I run around a lot and all. Been to a lot of places, met a lot of different characters, but you know what? You're still the best, I really mean it, M. You're not the {#Emph}fastest{#Prev}, mind! Can't have it all. But you and me? We cut it pretty close.

1.Text: I know you've been exceptionally busy as of late, though might I briefly interrupt our routine to give to you this little offering? It isn't much, but down here it's some of the best we've got.

2.Text: Don't know how you can find the {#Emph}time {#Prev}these days, though I am grateful that you thought of me like this! Now straight to business, then? Got lots to {#Emph}do!

1.Text: Where would we be without you, Lord Hermes? You've done so much to prepare us for the rigors we're having to endure. I know your efforts by their nature sometimes go unnoticed, but not by the Unseen.

2.Text: It's been a real pleasure working with you, M. One of the bright spots in all of this in fact! I keep my chin up no matter what, got to see where I'm going, right? Cheers for making it easy!

1.Text: If not for all your speed and bravery, we never would have had a fighting chance against our enemy, Hermes. I don't think we'll soon be able to repay you for this, but I can try!

2.Text: Right cordial of you, M, though I'm not much for tips and we've got pressing matters to attend to, don't you think? Though I appreciate it, honestly.

1.Text: I'm glad you're here, Hermes, and it's an honor to finally be working together. To our swift victory!

2.Text: Oh, hey! It's been a minute since I got an offering! Cheers, M, although you needn't have. But here, I've just the thing for you!

1.Text: Special delivery for you, Lord Hermes! You've aided me more times than I can count, and encouraged me every step of the way. I could never have come this far this quickly otherwise.

2.Text: Hey! Ambrosia! Just what I always wanted! Not seen it very often recently, nor the feasting that tends to go with it. Though at this rate we might soon have more! {#Emph}Feasting {#Prev}that is, which ought to be in your honor.

1.Text: Hermes, if there's anyone out there who can help me outpace Time, it's you. Please accept this, for your swift and reliable service.

2.Text: Right charitable of you, really, M, it's just I {#Emph}really {#Prev}need to move along, so let's get to the blessings if you please?

1.Text: Nothing like a quick exchange of gifts!
{#Emph}Oop!

2.Text: OK!

1.Text: Lord Hermes...

2.Text: Special delivery...

1.Text: Lord Hermes, go unseen.
You too!

2.Text: Hey hey!

1.Text: Olympus needs me... on the surface?
You know, it's gotten harder sneaking down into the Underworld of late! Good thing I happen to know an expert on the subject. And so do {#Emph}you{#Prev}, I see!
How long you think it's going to take to do away with all that Chronos Gold, another {#Emph}age {#Prev}or two? Not that you're slow, mind, more that he minted an awful lot of coins right quick!
The boatman always takes his toll, that's just the way it is! Though the benefits are {#Emph}more {#Prev}than worth the asking price, you got my guarantee!
What do you guess my professional associate does with all that coin, really? He still won't say a word. Think he's just covering his tracks so Gramps can't pin him down!
Cheers for your business, on behalf of my erstwhile professional associate there! Feels good to be working together with that one again, you tell him I said {#Emph}hrrnnggh!
{#Emph}I draw you down, O Moon. Lend me your light!

2.Text: {#Emph}I draw you down, O Moon. Lend me your light!

3.Text: {#Emph}I call upon the Moon, and draw you down!

4.Text: {#Emph}Let us together shine this night, O Moon!

5.Text: {#Emph}I bid you shine for me again tonight!

6.Text: Can moonlight guide me even in my dreams?

8.Text: {#Emph}It's all a dream, Selene, so here goes!

1.Text: You honor me, Sister.
To you, Selene! I never feel lost knowing the Moon herself is there to help me find my path.

2.Text: You are most kind to honor me this way. It doubtless shall sustain my steeds and me on long nights such as these. You have our thanks.

1.Text: Great Eye of Night, who watches over me, may your brilliance always shine across the world.

2.Text: The customary gifting of the gods... I am becoming fond of this cycle. Some traditions of Olympus may be worth adopting after all.

1.Text: O Moon, my steady friend through all these nights, I have for you this humble offering!

2.Text: I am grateful for your generosity. Though the kinship that we share is more than sufficient, and makes the lonely nights seem to soar by.

1.Text: Sister Selene, Eye of Night, you always have looked out for me since I was very small. But more than that, you've been a dependable comrade and true friend. The gods bestow such gifts to those they cherish, so I offer this to you.

2.Text: On countless nights have I observed your family on Olympus at their feasts, Ambrosia flowing in abundance. But, it was not the place for me, nor do we revel in the Crossroads thus. Yet from you, this is a cherished gift.

1.Text: May you shine forever bright, Sister Selene, my big sister, who protected me and guided me and taught me so much of patience and grace. This offering cannot begin to convey how much it means to me to have you in my life.

2.Text: You need not spare such words for me, though I am grateful for them, little star. As for the Ambrosia, I shall keep it for a time we Silver Sisters next may share of it together. As with the bond between us, it shall only grow in quality with age.

1.Text: Your silver light is shared by everyone, though I am far more fortunate as I know you yourself, Sister Selene. I never could have found my strength if not for yours.

2.Text: I always wished to be dependable, and you must feel the same. Though I watched over you, out of necessity we were quite distant as you grew and trained, but now? We Silver Sisters have grown close; as though we are one.

1.Text: In my lowest moments, when I felt most incapable and filled with doubt, you always believed in me, Sister. Your cycles across the sky are a steady source of calm and strength and inspiration, for you yourself are all that and more.

2.Text: Thank you for your offering and for your thoughts. I likewise never knew my birthparents when I was small, but Nyx in all her splendor took me in. I saw myself in you, I think, and felt perhaps a big sister could be of benefit...

1.Text: All creatures need you, Sister, not just gods; from the solitary wolf that howls in the night, to the sailor crossing waters you alone illuminate. You truly are an inspiration.

2.Text: I sometimes think Olympus takes my constancy for granted; for I receive many offerings from mortals, but not gods. While it should make no difference to me, nonetheless it does, little star. Thank you for the gesture.

1.Text: Selene, I now send to you the Nectar of the gods, that it may warm your passage 'cross the sky!

2.Text: But, little star, you offer this to me? The connection that we share as Silver Sisters is already more than I can ask. Now be that as it may, {#Emph}I {#Prev}have something for {#Emph}you.

1.Text: A new night sky affords a new beginning, does it not?

Long has the enchantress Circe understood that I do more than merely ride across the sky. She practices her incantations in accordance with the phases of my light; you can depend upon the power she bestows.
That Moon Beam of yours has grown exceptionally bright within your care. It shall illuminate your path forevermore; its power, at its peak. And whenever you have need of me, I shall be there.
I have arrived to join you at the outset of this cycle, to illuminate each step along your path. The path only appears familiar, so take care.
I sense that something is amiss tonight... as though I did not find you by my will. The Pitch-Black Stone... I see, of course. It is a weight on everything that we perceive.
Here in the sky, I am immune to earthly troubles, such as having to share living space with the goddess of retribution. Nemesis never treated me as a sister. She inherited only her mother's strength.
The monster Typhon, he has known defeat before. He has since grown in size, and strength, and fury, yet I hold to every faith you shall emerge victorious against him, little star.

We shall see to it that the rightful Queen and King of the Underworld retake their throne. Your father I knew only from Nyx's account, though I would see your mother when she visited Olympus. You have her regal bearing, little star.
The Titan of Foresight is conspiring with Heracles. Perhaps their love of mortalkind unites them; that or their relation to the gods. I felt they could have been each other's rivals, not your own.
Of late, your Headmistress asked me, do not your rides across the sky become monotonous? I was amused to hear her jest. Each night is like none other I have known.

Mother Nyx, in all her grace, began referring to me as the Eye of Night, for I could see even where she could not. This honor spurs me even now, just as I spur my steeds. We shall avenge her, little star.
I do not care to see the glimmer of the golden coins that Charon takes from you. It is far too much like the light of day, which likewise I can stand only so long.
My steeds were more than happy for this moment's rest.
You are hurt; your light is waning, little star. Do not lose heart. Our light never goes out. A new moon always rises.
The dark of night begins, as does your task. And I am here to usher you into that dark, toward inevitable victory, and death.
As I am full, I almost feel a tinge of pity for our enemies...
The night grows dark again, though you possess what light I now can offer.
Artemis revealed to Olympus what they need to know of you, and now is ranging through your woods. After our troubles have subsided, may all we Silver Sisters rejoice.
We breathe, we bleed, we rest, we start anew. Did we create this cycle, or are we merely part of it? Sometimes I ask myself this question while I ride.

Your Headmistress informed me that you finally located the Three Fates...? Then all is finally set right, although I feel as before... perhaps they wish to see what shall transpire if we each continue plotting out the course of our own lives.
Remember, little star: The magick that my light awakes in you requires active focus on your part; it has no power without your intent. In moments when you need it, do not hesitate.
I ought to welcome you more formally to our world's surface, little star. Part of me knew you would discover your way here. If you feel lost, you need but look aloft.
It is uncommon to have earned Queen Hera's Boon. She would confide in me sometimes while she would bathe. She has been more guarded as of late... as have we all.

Mortals often look upon us either with great reverence or fear; and thus they tell each other tales, making us out to be more than we are, or less. I have ceased blaming them, for what else are they to do?
I see you shine already with another light. The god Apollo's doing, I should think. Fear not; his power is compatible with mine. Light envelops light, never rejecting.
{#Emph}Death to Chronos. {#Prev}I sense that you are growing closer to manifesting the reality that we have long since sought. May you yet drain whatever light is left in him.

You have grown in experience so much using your craft that you managed even to rouse ever-sleeping Hypnos from his dreams? Mother Nyx has notified me that he is now back at his post, though with considerable make-up work...

You bear my Aspect, my Arcana, and my Moon Beam all at once? {#Emph}Oh{#Prev}, little star, you are yourself and need not seek to be like me. Although, perhaps my steeds would welcome a new rider at some point.
The city of Ephyra has seen so much strife. If only you could have witnessed it when its people still worshiped your mother and father. We shall avenge them all.
I remain troubled by the ever-sleeping son of Nyx, there in your Crossroads. Neither your Headmistress nor I have thus been able to awaken him. But every ailment must have a remedy...
My ride across the sky tends to be quite a solitary one. I have my steeds to speak to, yes. But it is not the same as when I have the opportunity to speak with you.
Here my light yields no greater strength than you experience below, for I give all I safely can wherever you reside. To be dependable and constant is my charge.
I am entirely enshrouded now; a new moon, for a new beginning. Use my cover of darkness to advance toward your goals.
We breathe, we bleed, we rest, we start anew.
The night is clear, my steeds are fresh; our power, unsurpassed.
Your Headmistress and I have worked together ever since Mother Nyx asked we watch over our domains, while she kept watch over the Underworld. Two Titanesses, bound by Night.
You have made peace with Nemesis, and more; perhaps beneath the surface she is not the goddess she has always seemed. If you deem her worthy, little star, that is enough.

Nothing escapes the notice of the Silver Sisters: I, in the heavens; the goddess of the hunt, on the surface; you, beneath the earth; and the Witch of the Crossroads, between realms. Now we no longer merely observe, but act.
As we are Silver Sisters, all my strength is yours.

You have begun to understand the secrets of the Black Coat. One, I can share; a waking-phrase to utter by the Silver Pool: {#Emph}I see you bring bliss and destruction in your outstretched arms. {#Prev}Remember it, and speak it, little star.

Nyx spoke highly of your brother to me, little star. I too am distant from my brother Helios, the Sun. Sometimes I slow my steeds to catch a glimpse of him as he engulfs the surface. I do not think we would have much to talk about.
The great King of the Olympians bestowed on you some of his thunderous strength. It ought to be more than sufficient on its own, but let us not leave anything to chance.

You vanquished Chronos in another time...? Or {#Emph}of {#Prev}another time, and with the self-same Titan's aid. Such mysteries his power holds. But if this is what it takes for our time to flow freely forward, then let us see that it is done.

Perhaps some morning on the surface you shall finally see Eos, little star. She is quite beautiful, so much that mortals now admire her. But I have never known her very well. She makes her brief appearances, then she is gone.
Whenever you invoke me thus, I urge my steeds toward the earth, as far as they dare tread. They are becoming braver, I should think. Now please use well the power I reveal in you.

You faced the Titan in the lowest depths... that much I knew before your Headmistress confirmed you vanquished him, as I had faith you would. If his life-force is like grains of sand, then you took one; eventually, {#Emph}all.

The Titans Chronos and Prometheus have forged an alliance, yet are not so much alike. Prometheus longs for a world in which mortals do not answer to gods? He of all beings must know that shall never come to pass.
I watched the goddess Aphrodite seek you out. From her I learned a bit of how to influence the heart. But only when my strength is at its peak, and even then, I fear I pale in comparison.
My Moon Beams are as innumerable as the stars, and you possess but one; but it is one I chose especially for you, and shall ensure that our connection remains strong.
I see often the gleaming Sister Blades within your grasp. I knew eventually that they would reawaken and accept you as their bearer. May their swiftness overwhelm your foes.
This strange sensation... I remember what it is: the whims of Chaos, affecting our surroundings even if in subtle ways. I have faith that this is due to your actions, not chance.
Even in darkest Erebus, I hear and see you, little star.
The second Guardians that bar your passage fell to you despite the Vow of Rivals granting them the strength of Night herself. But be forewarned: The Vow's effect shall grow more trying from here on.
Until the Silver Sisters can lay down their arms.
You have lost much of your lifeblood already. Then perhaps I am too late this time. But while you still can stand, you still can harness the great power I illuminate in you.
By now, that monster Typhon must remember the bitter taste of defeat, yet he does not relent. Thus he has left us with no choice but to pursue the means of his annihilation, little star.
I have descended, and my light again is yours.

Such a joyous night it was when you and your Headmistress and the goddess of the hunt and I all rode together on my steeds. Now we are each once more where we belong, but the Silver Sisters are never truly apart.

You bear the Aspect I revealed to you before. I know little of this Shiva save their reputation as destroyer of all things. Perhaps the Black Coat partly is responsible, though that is for you to discover now.
I have grown so accustomed to locating you within the Underworld that I am still surprised at times to find you aboveground. This is easier for me, yet more difficult for you, is it not?

I felt a weight drawing me toward the Crossroads recently, and realized it was the Pitch-Black Stone. So then it has awakened... almost like an Eye itself, but far older than mine, and peering from the infinite abyss.
It pleases me whenever you have opportunity to call.

She's deviated from her path... 

 {#Emph}Great Titaness, the Eye of Night, 
 {#Emph}I draw you down; lend me your might!

2.Text: Good evening to you, little star. Our cycles now are intertwined, as I no longer can afford merely to watch. Whichever threat we face, I vow to shine for you.

1.Text: The Black Coat's Aspect of Mother Nyx... I knew that she once wielded Xinth herself but never witnessed it, for she could bend even {#Emph}my {#Prev}light aside. Such an honor that her Aspect has revealed itself to you.
Once more we meet in secret in the dead of night.

I harbored such hatred for the Titan Chronos, for all that he had done; for all he put you through. Yet now he himself is working to undo the harm he caused? Such power you possess, to have brought about such change.
You now possess the Argent Skull Revaal... an everlasting reminder that Death and Fear ought always to be allies in our cause. Woe unto whomever meets her gaze.
The god of war decided that his intervention is required, and has granted you some of his violent strength. It may seem difficult to trust in Ares, but his motivations I have found to be quite clear.
I found you, though my light is but a flicker at these depths. You trace the secret path between Poseidon's and your father's realms. What lurks here has no love for either one.
